examples.target: 有些人擔心機器人會奪走人類的工作。

examples.source: Some articles discuss whether AI will take jobs away.
examples.target: 有些文章討論人工智能會否取代職位。

examples.source: New machines can take jobs away in some industries.
examples.target: 新機器可能在某些行業取代職位。

examples.source: Our school will take on more students next year.
examples.target: 我們學校明年會接收更多學生。

examples.source: She decided to take on extra duties for the school fair.
examples.target: 她決定為學校嘉年華承擔額外職責。

examples.source: The company is ready to take on new staff now.
examples.target: 這間公司現在準備好接收新員工了。

examples.source: I am not ready to take on more responsibilities at school this year.
examples.target: 我今年還未準備好在學校承擔更多責任。

examples.source: Our school team decided to take on a much stronger opponent tomorrow.
examples.target: 我們校隊決定明天去挑戰一支更強大的對手。

examples.source: She decided to take on the role of class monitor for this term.
examples.target: 她決定在本學期擔任班長一職。

take on a challenge.meaning: 接受挑戰 / 承擔挑戰

examples.source: I want to take on a challenge to improve my English.
examples.target: 我想接受挑戰，以提升我的英語水平。

examples.source: She decided to take on a challenge by joining the team.
examples.target: 她決定加入隊伍，接受這個挑戰。

examples.source: The students learned a lot when they took on a challenge.
examples.target: 學生們接受挑戰時學到了很多東西。

examples.source: I want to take on new challenges to improve my skills.
examples.target: 我想接受新挑戰來提升我的技能。

examples.source: She feels excited when she can take on new challenges.
examples.target: 當她能夠接受新挑戰時，她感到很興奮。

examples.source: Our class feels excited to take on new challenges.
examples.target: 我們班對接受新挑戰感到很興奮。

examples.source: Some older students take on part-time work during holidays.
examples.target: 有些高年級學生會在假期從事兼職工作。

examples.source: I want to take on part-time work if I have time.
examples.target: 如果我有時間的話，我想從事兼職工作。

examples.source: She decided to take on part-time work because she needed money.
examples.target: 因為需要錢，她決定從事兼職工作。

examples.source: You must take on the responsibility for your own homework.
examples.target: 你必須為自己的功課承擔責任。

examples.source: He decided to take on the responsibility of leading the team.
examples.target: 他決定承擔起帶領團隊的責任。

examples.source: If you break the toy, you should take on the responsibility.
examples.target: 如果你弄壞了玩具，你應該承擔責任。

examples.source: My parents need to take out a loan to buy a house.
examples.target: 我父母需要申請貸款來買房子。

examples.source: The article explains why some families take out a loan for education.
examples.target: 文章解釋了為何有些家庭會為教育申請貸款。

examples.source: A loan agreement explains when the borrower must pay the money back.
examples.target: 貸款協議會說明借款人何時需要還款。

examples.source: Our monitor took the lead and started the group project.
examples.target: 班長帶頭開始了小組習作。

examples.source: Our team captain will take the lead during the basketball game.
examples.target: 籃球比賽期間，我們的隊長會負責帶頭。

examples.source: She decided to take the lead when nobody else wanted to.
examples.target: 當其他人都不願意時，她決定率先行動。

examples.source: I want to take up an instrument during the summer holidays.
examples.target: 我想在暑假期間開始學一種樂器。

examples.source: He decided to take up an instrument after watching the concert.
examples.target: 看完音樂會後，他決定開始學一種樂器。

examples.source: My cousin decided to take up an instrument after the concert.
examples.target: 表演會後，我的表親決定開始學一種樂器。

examples.source: I want to take up cycling during the summer holiday.
examples.target: 我想在暑假開始踩單車。

examples.source: My brother decided to take up cycling during the holidays.
examples.target: 我哥哥決定在假期時開始踩單車。

examples.source: My friend decided to take up cycling with his brother.
examples.target: 我的朋友決定和哥哥一起開始踩單車。

examples.source: These old boxes take up room in my small bedroom.
examples.target: 這些舊箱子佔用了我睡房裡的空間。

examples.source: The large box takes up room near the classroom door.
examples.target: 那個大箱子佔用了課室門口附近的空間。

examples.source: The large sofa takes up room in the living area.
examples.target: 這張大梳化佔用了客廳的空間。

examples.source: These old books take up space on my small desk.
examples.target: 這些舊書佔用了我書桌上的空間。

examples.source: The old printer takes up space on the teacher’s desk.
examples.target: 那部舊打印機佔用了老師桌上的空間。

examples.source: If you have too many toys, they take up space.
examples.target: 如果你有太多玩具，它們會佔用空間。

take up sports.meaning: 開始做運動 / 開始參與體育

examples.source: I want to take up sports to stay healthy this year.
examples.target: 今年我想開始做運動，保持身體健康。

examples.source: He decided to take up sports after school with his friends.
examples.target: 他決定放學後和朋友一起開始參與體育活動。

examples.source: The school encourages students to take up sports after class.
examples.target: 學校鼓勵學生課後開始參與體育活動。

examples.source: Playing video games can take up time when I have homework.
examples.target: 當我有功課要做時，打遊戲機可能會佔用時間。

examples.source: These long meetings always take up time during my busy day.
examples.target: 這些冗長的會議總是在我忙碌的一天中佔用時間。

examples.source: I do not want to take up time if you are busy.
examples.target: 如果你很忙的話，我不想佔用你的時間。

examples.source: Be careful not to tip over your glass of water.
examples.target: 小心點，不要把你的水杯弄翻了。

examples.source: The heavy wind caused the empty trash can to tip over.
examples.target: 大風把那個空的垃圾桶吹翻了。

examples.source: If you stand on the chair, it might tip over.
examples.target: 如果你站在椅子上，它可能會翻倒。

examples.source: It is better to tell him the truth to his face.
examples.target: 最好還是當面告訴他真相。

examples.source: She was too shy to criticize his work to his face.
examples.target: 她太害羞了，不敢當面批評他的作品。

examples.source: He never says anything bad about me to my face.
examples.target: 他從來不會當面說我的壞話。

examples.source: Be careful not to trip over your school bag on the floor.
examples.target: 小心別被地上的書包絆倒。

examples.source: I did not see the wire and tripped over it yesterday.
examples.target: 我昨天沒看見那條電線，結果被絆倒了。

examples.source: She tripped over the rug while carrying her books.
examples.target: 她拿著書時被地毯絆倒了。

try one's luck.meaning: 碰碰運氣 / 試試運氣

examples.source: I will try my luck at the school lucky draw today.
examples.target: 我今天會在學校的抽獎活動中碰碰運氣。

examples.source: He decided to try his luck by applying for the job.
examples.target: 他決定申請這份工作，試試自己的運氣。

examples.source: If you are bored, let's try our luck at the arcade.
examples.target: 如果你覺得無聊，我們去遊戲機中心碰碰運氣吧。

examples.source: The party turned out to be much better than I expected.
examples.target: 派對的結果比我預期的好得多。

examples.source: It turned out that he had forgotten to lock the door.
examples.target: 原來他忘記了鎖門。

examples.source: The weather turned out nice, so we went for a picnic.
examples.target: 天氣結果變得很好，所以我們去野餐。

examples.source: The T-Rex was a large dinosaur that lived long ago.
examples.target: 暴龍是一種很久以前生活的大型恐龍。

examples.source: I saw a giant T-Rex model when I visited the museum.
examples.target: 我參觀博物館時看見了一個巨大的暴龍模型。

examples.source: The book explains what scientists know about the T-Rex.
examples.target: 這本書解釋科學家對暴龍的認識。

examples.source: Please put the clean tablecloth on the dining table.
examples.target: 請把乾淨的枱布鋪在餐桌上。

examples.source: I spilled some juice on the new tablecloth today.
examples.target: 我今天不小心把果汁灑在新的枱布上了。

examples.source: The tablecloth looks beautiful when we have dinner together.
examples.target: 當我們一起吃晚餐時，這張枱布看起來很漂亮。

examples.source: Please clear the tabletop before we start our homework together.
examples.target: 在我們一起做功課之前，請清理一下桌面。

examples.source: I accidentally spilled some water on the wooden tabletop today.
examples.target: 我今天不小心把水灑在了木製桌面上。

examples.source: The tabletop is too small for all of my textbooks.
examples.target: 這張桌面太小了，放不下我所有的教科書。

examples.source: I practise taekwondo every Saturday.
examples.target: 我每星期六練習跆拳道。

examples.source: She felt confident when she wore her taekwondo uniform.
examples.target: 她穿上跆拳道道袍時感到有自信。

examples.source: The taekwondo class practised kicks in the sports hall.
examples.target: 跆拳道班在體育館練習踢腿。

examples.source: We cooked a chicken tagine for dinner last night.
examples.target: 我們昨晚煮了一道塔吉鍋燉雞。

examples.source: The tagine keeps the meat tender while it cooks.
examples.target: 塔吉鍋在烹煮時能讓肉質保持鮮嫩。

examples.source: The restaurant serves vegetable tagine with rice.
examples.target: 這間餐廳供應配飯的塔吉鍋燉蔬菜。

examples.source: My brother is a fast talker when he gets excited.
examples.target: 我哥哥興奮時說話很快。

examples.source: She is a good talker and tells interesting stories.
examples.target: 她很健談，會說有趣的故事。

examples.source: The radio host is a lively talker.
examples.target: 那位電台主持人很健談又有活力。

examples.source: They learned how to dance the tango in the school hall.
examples.target: 他們在學校禮堂學習如何跳探戈。

examples.source: The music changed when the couple started to dance the tango.
examples.target: 當那對舞伴開始跳探戈時，音樂隨之改變了。

examples.source: My sister practices the tango every weekend to improve her skills.
examples.target: 我姐姐每個週末都練習探戈，以提升她的舞技。

examples.source: He came back from his beach holiday with a tanned face.
examples.target: 他從海灘度假回來，臉曬黑了。

examples.source: My skin gets tanned easily when I play sports outside.
examples.target: 我在戶外做運動時，皮膚很容易曬黑。

examples.source: The tanned tourists walked along the pier.
examples.target: 曬黑了的遊客沿著碼頭散步。

tasteless.meaning: 沒有味道的 / 淡而無味的

examples.source: This soup is tasteless because there is not enough salt.
examples.target: 這碗湯沒有味道，因為鹽不夠。

examples.source: The vegetables became tasteless after being boiled for too long.
examples.target: 這些蔬菜煮得太久後變得淡而無味。

examples.source: The snack looked good but tasted tasteless.
examples.target: 這款零食看起來不錯，但吃起來淡而無味。

examples.source: Some artists tattoo small symbols for customers.
examples.target: 有些藝術師會為顧客刺上小圖案。

examples.source: The machine is used to tattoo designs onto skin.
examples.target: 這部機器用來把圖案刺在皮膚上。

examples.source: The documentary showed how people tattoo traditional patterns.
examples.target: 紀錄片展示人們如何刺上傳統圖案。

examples.source: He has a small tattoo of a star on his arm.
examples.target: 他的手臂上有一個星星小紋身。

examples.source: The museum photo showed an old tribal tattoo.
examples.target: 博物館照片展示了一個古老部族紋身。

examples.source: The tattoo has a special meaning for her family.
examples.target: 這個紋身對她的家庭有特別意義。

examples.source: The artist has a small tattooed star on her wrist.
examples.target: 那位藝術家的手腕上有一個刺上去的小星星。

examples.source: The tattooed pattern was part of a traditional design.
examples.target: 那個紋身圖案是傳統設計的一部分。

examples.source: The photo showed a tattooed sailor from long ago.
examples.target: 照片展示了一位很久以前有紋身的水手。

tbc.meaning: 待定的 / 有待確認的

examples.source: The date for our next school trip is still TBC.
examples.target: 我們下次學校旅行的日期仍然待定。

examples.source: The exact time of the meeting is TBC.
examples.target: 會議的確實時間有待確認。

examples.source: We have a plan, but the venue is currently TBC.
examples.target: 我們已有計劃，但場地目前仍待確認。

examples.source: We played some fun team-building games during the school camp.
examples.target: 我們在學校營地玩了一些有趣的團隊建立遊戲。

examples.source: The company organized a team-building activity to improve our communication.
examples.target: 公司舉辦了一項團隊建立活動來改善我們的溝通。

examples.source: These team-building exercises help us work better as a group.
examples.target: 這些團隊建立練習有助於我們以小組形式更好地合作。

examples.source: She is a great team-player because she always helps others.
examples.target: 她是一位很好的團隊成員，因為她總是樂於助人。

examples.source: A team-player listens to other people in the group.
examples.target: 有團隊精神的人會聆聽小組中其他人的意見。

examples.source: Our coach likes him because he is a real team-player.
examples.target: 教練很喜歡他，因為他非常有團隊精神。

examples.source: It is not kind to tease classmates about their clothes.
examples.target: 取笑同學的衣著是不友善的行為。

examples.source: My brother sometimes teases me when I try to cook.
examples.target: 當我嘗試煮食時，我哥哥有時會取笑我。

examples.source: The story shows how teasing can hurt people.
examples.target: 這個故事展示取笑別人可能會令人受傷。

examples.source: We usually have snacks and tea during teatime.
examples.target: 我們通常會在下午茶時間吃點零食和喝茶。

examples.source: My grandmother likes to eat egg tarts at teatime.
examples.target: 我祖母喜歡在下午茶時間吃蛋撻。

examples.source: The cafe is busy around teatime.
examples.target: 咖啡店在下午茶時間左右很忙。

examples.source: We enjoyed a tech-free weekend at home.
examples.target: 我們在家享受了一個不用科技產品的週末。

examples.source: The school organized a tech-free camp for students.
examples.target: 學校為學生舉辦了一個不用科技產品的營會。

examples.source: The family had a tech-free dinner and talked together.
examples.target: 這家人吃了一頓不用科技產品的晚餐，並一起聊天。

examples.source: We need to buy some new tech-related equipment for school.
examples.target: 我們需要為學校購買一些與科技有關的設備。

examples.source: He enjoys reading tech-related news on his tablet every day.
examples.target: 他每天都喜歡在平板電腦上閱讀與科技有關的新聞。

examples.source: If you have any tech-related questions, please ask the teacher.
examples.target: 如果你有任何與科技有關的問題，請詢問老師。

examples.source: Technically, the game is over, but we can play again.
examples.target: 嚴格來說，比賽已經結束，但我們可以再玩一次。

examples.source: This plan is technically possible, but it will be difficult.
examples.target: 這個計劃技術上可行，但會很困難。

examples.source: Technically, a tomato is a fruit, not a vegetable.
examples.target: 嚴格來說，番茄是一種水果，而不是蔬菜。

examples.source: The technician fixed our school computer when it stopped working.
examples.target: 學校電腦停止運作時，技術員把它修好了。

examples.source: A technician checked the air conditioner in the classroom.
examples.target: 一位技術員檢查了課室的冷氣機。

examples.source: A skilled technician came to install the internet.
examples.target: 一位熟練的技術員前來安裝網絡。

examples.source: Our school is becoming more technologically advanced with the new computer lab.
examples.target: 有了新的電腦室，我們學校在科技方面變得更加先進。

examples.source: The classroom has improved technologically over the past few years.
examples.target: 這間課室在過去幾年於科技方面有所提升。

examples.source: This new device is technologically superior to the one I bought last year.
examples.target: 這款新裝置在科技方面比我去年買的那部更勝一籌。

technophobe.meaning: 害怕科技的人 / 抗拒科技的人

examples.source: My grandfather is a total technophobe who refuses to even use a smartphone.
examples.target: 我爺爺是個十足的科技恐懼者，連智能手機都不肯用。

examples.source: Even though she is a technophobe, she is trying her best to learn how to use the new computer system.
examples.target: 雖然她很抗拒科技，但她正努力學習如何使用這套新電腦系統。

examples.source: The company hired a tutor to help the older staff, as many of them are technophobes.
examples.target: 公司請了一位導師來協助資深員工，因為他們當中許多人都對科技感到抗拒。

tectonics.meaning: 構造地質學 / 板塊運動

examples.source: The study of plate tectonics helps scientists understand why earthquakes occur.
examples.target: 研究板塊運動有助於科學家了解地震發生的原因。

examples.source: The island was formed millions of years ago due to shifting tectonics.
examples.target: 這座島嶼是數百萬年前因板塊構造運動而形成的。

examples.source: Geologists are using new technology to monitor the tectonics of the region.
examples.target: 地質學家正利用新技術監測該地區的構造地質活動。

examples.source: The market was teeming with people doing their weekend shopping.
examples.target: 街市擠滿了正在辦週末採購的人。

examples.source: The river is teeming with fish during the summer months.
examples.target: 夏季期間，這條河裡充滿了魚。

examples.source: The city streets are teeming with tourists from all over the world.
examples.target: 城市街道上擠滿了來自世界各地的遊客。

examples.source: My father has worked in the telecoms industry for over twenty years.
examples.target: 我爸爸在電訊業工作已經超過二十年了。

examples.source: The government is trying to improve the quality of local telecoms services.
examples.target: 政府正致力於提升本地電訊服務的質素。

examples.source: Many students rely on stable telecoms networks to finish their online homework.
examples.target: 許多學生依賴穩定的電訊網絡來完成網上功課。

examples.source: The local station will televise the school swimming gala live next Friday.
examples.target: 電視台將會於下星期五直播學校的游泳比賽。

examples.source: They decided to televise the charity concert to help raise more funds.
examples.target: 他們決定電視轉播這場慈善音樂會，以籌集更多善款。

examples.source: The basketball match will be televised this weekend.
examples.target: 這場籃球比賽將於本週末電視播出。

examples.source: We watched the televised football match on the big screen.
examples.target: 我們在屏幕上觀看了那場電視轉播的足球比賽。

examples.source: The televised debate will start at eight o'clock tonight.
examples.target: 那場電視轉播的辯論將於今晚八點開始。

examples.source: Many people enjoyed the televised concert from their homes.
examples.target: 許多人在家中欣賞那場電視播放的音樂會。

telling.meaning: 很能說明問題的 / 反映真相的

examples.source: The silence in the room was telling, as no one wanted to support his plan.
examples.target: 房間裡的沉默很能說明問題，因為根本沒人想支持他的計劃。

examples.source: Her telling expression revealed that she already knew the truth about the surprise.
examples.target: 她那反映真相的表情，流露出她早已知道這個驚喜的內情。

examples.source: It is telling that the company decided to cancel the project right after the audit.
examples.target: 公司在審計後隨即決定取消項目，這件事很能說明問題。

examples.source: The company hired a temp to help with the office filing work.
examples.target: 公司請了一位臨時員工來協助處理辦公室的存檔工作。

examples.source: She worked as a temp during the summer to earn extra money.
examples.target: 她在暑假期間擔任臨時員工，賺取額外的零用錢。

examples.source: Our manager is looking for a reliable temp to cover the leave.
examples.target: 我們的經理正在尋找一位可靠的臨時員工來頂替請假的人。

examples.source: My mother often cooks delicious tempeh for our healthy weekend lunch.
examples.target: 我媽媽經常為我們週末的健康午餐烹調美味的天貝。

examples.source: Tempeh is a popular plant-based protein for people who eat vegetarian food.
examples.target: 對素食者來說，天貝是一種很受歡迎的植物性蛋白質。

examples.source: The chef stir-fried tempeh with fresh vegetables for the lunch set.
examples.target: 廚師把天貝和新鮮蔬菜一起炒，作為午餐套餐。

examples.source: She has a calm temperament, which makes her a great leader.
examples.target: 她性情冷靜，這使她成為一位出色的領導者。

examples.source: The two brothers have completely different temperaments.
examples.target: 這兩兄弟的性情截然不同。

examples.source: A patient temperament is useful when solving difficult problems.
examples.target: 有耐性的性情有助於處理困難問題。

examples.source: The region has a temperate climate with mild winters and warm summers.
examples.target: 這個地區屬於溫帶氣候，冬天溫和，夏天溫暖。

examples.source: She is known for her temperate personality and rarely gets angry.
examples.target: 她以性格溫和著稱，很少會發脾氣。

examples.source: Temperate forests are home to a wide variety of plants and animals.
examples.target: 溫帶森林是許多動植物的棲息地。

tempted.meaning: 想做某事的 / 受誘惑的

examples.source: I was tempted to eat the cake before dinner.
examples.target: 晚飯前，我真的很想吃那塊蛋糕。

examples.source: She felt tempted to buy the dress when she saw it.
examples.target: 她看到那條裙子時，就很想把它買下來。

examples.source: He was tempted to stay at home because the weather was rainy.
examples.target: 因為天氣下雨，他很想留在家中。

tenable.meaning: 站得住腳的 / 可行的

examples.source: The student's argument was not tenable because he lacked sufficient evidence.
examples.target: 由於缺乏足夠證據，該名學生的論點站不住腳。

examples.source: We need to come up with a more tenable plan for the school project.
examples.target: 我們需要為學校專題研習制定一個更可行的計劃。

examples.source: His position as team leader is no longer tenable after the recent mistakes.
examples.target: 在犯下連串錯誤後，他已不再適合擔任隊長一職。

examples.source: Her success is a result of her incredible tenacity and hard work.
examples.target: 她的成功歸功於她驚人的毅力和努力。

examples.source: The athlete showed great tenacity by finishing the race despite her injury.
examples.target: 這位運動員展現了極大的韌性，儘管受傷仍堅持跑完全程。

examples.source: Learning a new language often requires tenacity over a long period of time.
examples.target: 學習一種新語言往往需要長時間的堅持。

examples.source: The landlord decided to renew our tenancy for another two years.
examples.target: 業主決定將我們的租約續期兩年。

examples.source: The terms of the tenancy are written clearly in the contract.
examples.target: 租約條款清楚寫在合約內。

examples.source: The tenancy agreement clearly states the responsibilities of both the tenant and the landlord.
examples.target: 租約清楚列明了租客與業主雙方的責任。

examples.source: Tencha is the raw material used to produce high-quality matcha.
examples.target: 碾茶是製作優質抹茶的原材料。

examples.source: The leaves are carefully shaded before they are harvested as tencha.
examples.target: 茶葉在收割成碾茶前會經過細心遮蔭。

examples.source: After being de-stemmed and de-veined, the tencha is ground into a fine powder.
examples.target: 碾茶在去除莖和葉脈後，會被磨成細粉。

examples.source: The athlete suffered an injury to his Achilles tendon during the race.
examples.target: 這名運動員在比賽中阿基里斯腱受傷。

examples.source: A tendon connects a muscle to a bone.
examples.target: 肌腱把肌肉和骨骼連接起來。

examples.source: The diagram shows the tendon at the back of the ankle.
examples.target: 這幅圖顯示了腳踝後方的肌腱。

examples.source: I felt very tense before my piano exam started.
examples.target: 鋼琴考試開始前，我感到非常緊張。

examples.source: The atmosphere in the room was tense during the game.
examples.target: 比賽期間，房間裡的氣氛變得十分緊張。

examples.source: He looked tense because he had to give a speech.
examples.target: 因為要上台演講，他看起來很緊張。

examples.source: We have made a tentative plan to visit Japan next summer.
examples.target: 我們已經擬定了一個明年夏天去日本旅遊的暫定計劃。

examples.source: She gave a tentative smile, unsure if she was welcome.
examples.target: 她露出了試探性的微笑，不確定自己是否受歡迎。

examples.source: The date for the meeting is still tentative.
examples.target: 會議日期仍然是暫定的。

examples.source: We have tentatively scheduled the meeting for next Tuesday.
examples.target: 我們已暫定下星期二舉行會議。

examples.source: She tentatively reached out to touch the puppy.
examples.target: 她試探性地伸手摸了摸那隻小狗。

examples.source: The plan is only tentatively agreed upon by both sides.
examples.target: 雙方目前只是暫定同意這項計劃。

terminally.meaning: 末期地 / 無法挽回地

examples.source: The charity supports terminally ill children and their families.
examples.target: 這個慈善機構支援末期病童及其家庭。

examples.source: The plan was terminally flawed from the very beginning.
examples.target: 這個計劃從一開始就存在無法挽回的缺陷。

examples.source: The old machine was terminally damaged after the flood.
examples.target: 那部舊機器在水災後受到無法修復的損壞。

examples.source: The company announced the immediate termination of his employment contract.
examples.target: 公司宣佈即時終止他的僱傭合約。

examples.source: We are discussing the possible termination of the project due to a lack of funding.
examples.target: 由於缺乏資金，我們正在討論終止該項目的可能性。

examples.source: The sudden termination of the service caused a lot of inconvenience to the users.
examples.target: 這項服務的突然終止為用戶帶來了許多不便。

examples.source: The science textbook uses a lot of technical terminology that is hard to understand.
examples.target: 這本科學課本用了許多很難理解的專業術語。

examples.source: This glossary explains computer terminology in simple words.
examples.target: 這份詞彙表用簡單文字解釋電腦術語。

examples.source: Legal terminology can be difficult for ordinary readers.
examples.target: 法律術語對一般讀者來說可能很難理解。

examples.source: The wooden furniture in our living room was damaged by a termite colony.
examples.target: 我們客廳的木製家具被一窩白蟻破壞了。

examples.source: The inspection report found termite damage in the old house.
examples.target: 檢查報告發現那間舊屋有白蟻造成的損壞。

examples.source: A termite colony can weaken wooden structures over time.
examples.target: 一窩白蟻可以隨著時間削弱木製結構。

examples.source: We sat on the terrace and enjoyed the beautiful view of the city.
examples.target: 我們坐在露台上，欣賞著城市美麗的景色。

examples.source: The cafe has a lovely outdoor terrace where customers can drink their coffee.
examples.target: 這間咖啡店有個很棒的戶外露台，顧客可以在那裡喝咖啡。

examples.source: The farmer planted many vegetables on the green terrace of the steep hill.
examples.target: 農夫在陡峭山坡的階梯地上種植了許多蔬菜。

terraced.meaning: 梯田式的 / 露台式的

examples.source: The village is famous for its beautiful terraced rice fields.
examples.target: 這條村莊以其美麗的梯田而聞名。

examples.source: We enjoyed a coffee on the hotel's terraced balcony overlooking the sea.
examples.target: 我們在酒店那露台式的陽台上喝咖啡，欣賞海景。

examples.source: The garden was designed with several terraced levels to make the most of the sloping land.
examples.target: 花園設計成幾層梯田式的平台，以充分利用傾斜的地勢。

examples.source: Scientists are exploring the possibility of terraforming Mars to make it habitable for humans.
examples.target: 科學家正在探索將火星進行地球化改造，使其適合人類居住的可能性。

examples.source: In many science fiction stories, terraforming is the key to colonizing distant planets.
examples.target: 在許多科幻故事中，地球化改造是殖民遙遠行星的關鍵。

examples.source: The process of terraforming a planet would take hundreds of years to complete.
examples.target: 對一顆行星進行地球化改造的過程需要數百年才能完成。

examples.source: Scientists are studying how terrestrial plants adapt to changes in the climate.
examples.target: 科學家正在研究陸生植物如何適應氣候變化。

examples.source: The island has a unique ecosystem that supports both terrestrial and aquatic life.
examples.target: 這座島嶼擁有獨特的生態系統，同時孕育著陸地和水生生物。

examples.source: Some insects have both aquatic and terrestrial stages in their life cycle.
examples.target: 有些昆蟲在生命週期中同時有水生和陸生階段。

terrified.meaning: 非常害怕的 / 驚恐的

examples.source: The little boy was terrified when he heard the loud thunder.
examples.target: 那個小男孩聽到響亮的雷聲時感到非常害怕。

examples.source: I felt terrified during the dark scene in the film.
examples.target: 電影中的黑暗場面令我感到非常害怕。

examples.source: She felt terrified when the lights suddenly went out at night.
examples.target: 當晚上的燈突然熄滅時，她感到非常驚恐。

examples.source: Many students plan to pursue tertiary education after finishing their secondary school studies.
examples.target: 許多學生計劃在完成中學學業後，繼續升讀大專院校。

examples.source: The government provides financial support for students attending various local tertiary institutions.
examples.target: 政府為就讀各類本地大專院校的學生提供經濟援助。

examples.source: She is working hard to meet the entry requirements for her preferred tertiary course.
examples.target: 她正努力達到心儀大專課程的入學要求。

examples.source: The success of this project is a testament to the team's hard work.
examples.target: 這個項目的成功，證明了團隊付出的努力。

examples.source: Her long career in education stands as a testament to her dedication.
examples.target: 她在教育界長期的工作生涯，見證了她的敬業精神。

examples.source: These old photos are a testament to how much the city has changed.
examples.target: 這些舊照片見證了這座城市經歷了多大的變化。

examples.source: The software tester checked the app for any hidden bugs.
examples.target: 軟件測試員檢查了應用程式，看看有沒有隱藏的錯誤。

examples.source: A tester checked the school website before it was shown to parents.
examples.target: 一名測試員檢查了學校網站，才讓家長瀏覽。

examples.source: The game tester played the new level to find any problems.
examples.target: 遊戲測試員玩了新關卡，以找出當中的問題。

examples.source: The company posted a positive testimonial from a satisfied customer online.
examples.target: 公司在網上發布了一則來自滿意顧客的好評。

examples.source: She wrote a warm testimonial for her former teacher.
examples.target: 她為以前的老師寫了一份溫暖的推薦評語。

examples.source: The website shows several testimonials from parents and students.
examples.target: 該網站展示了數則來自家長和學生的推薦評語。

tethered.meaning: 被繫住的 / 被固定住的

examples.source: The boat was tethered to the wooden dock to prevent it from drifting away.
examples.target: 那艘船被繫在木碼頭上，以防它漂走。

examples.source: The astronaut remained tethered to the spacecraft while performing repairs outside.
examples.target: 太空人在太空船外進行維修時，身體一直繫在船身上。

examples.source: A small dog was tethered to a post outside the coffee shop.
examples.target: 一隻小狗被繫在咖啡店外的一根柱子上。

examples.source: He stopped texting when the teacher walked into the classroom.
examples.target: 當老師走進課室時，他停止了發短訊。

examples.source: I find texting much faster than calling my friends.
examples.target: 我覺得發短訊比打電話給朋友快得多。

examples.source: Texting while crossing a busy road can be dangerous.
examples.target: 過繁忙馬路時發短訊可能很危險。

examples.source: The artist focused on the textural details of the painting to make it look more realistic.
examples.target: 這位藝術家專注於畫作的質感細節，使其看起來更逼真。

examples.source: This new fabric offers a unique textural experience that feels very soft against the skin.
examples.target: 這款新布料帶來獨特的質感體驗，觸感非常柔軟。

examples.source: The interior designer added rugs and cushions to create more textural contrast in the living room.
examples.target: 室內設計師加入了地毯和靠墊，為客廳營造出更豐富的質感對比。

examples.source: We always eat a big dinner during Thanksgiving every year.
examples.target: 我們每年感恩節都會吃一頓豐富的晚餐。

examples.source: My family visits my grandparents for Thanksgiving in November.
examples.target: 十一月感恩節時，我會和家人一起去探望祖父母。

examples.source: I am thankful for my friends when I celebrate Thanksgiving.
examples.target: 慶祝感恩節時，我很感謝身邊的朋友。

examples.source: The frozen chicken thawed slowly in the fridge overnight.
examples.target: 急凍雞肉在雪櫃裡過了一晚後慢慢解凍。

examples.source: The ice on the lake began to thaw as the spring sun warmed the air.
examples.target: 隨著春天的太陽讓空氣變暖，湖上的冰開始融化。

examples.source: Diplomatic relations between the two countries finally started to thaw after years of tension.
examples.target: 經過多年的緊張局勢，兩國之間的外交關係終於開始緩和。

therapeutic.meaning: 有療癒作用的 / 有助放鬆的

examples.source: Listening to calm music can be a therapeutic experience after school.
examples.target: 放學後聽些平靜的音樂，可以是一種非常療癒的體驗。

examples.source: Painting is a therapeutic hobby that helps people relax after a long day.
examples.target: 繪畫是一種有助放鬆的愛好，能幫助人在忙碌的一天後平靜下來。

examples.source: A quiet walk in the park felt therapeutic during the exam period.
examples.target: 考試期間，在公園安靜散步令人感到放鬆和療癒。

examples.source: The contract is legally binding, and all the terms therein must be followed.
examples.target: 這份合約具有法律約束力，必須遵守其中列出的所有條款。

examples.source: He opened the old box and found a dusty letter hidden therein.
examples.target: 他打開那個舊盒子，發現裡面藏著一封佈滿灰塵的信。

examples.source: The report provides a detailed analysis and the conclusions reached therein.
examples.target: 這份報告提供了詳細的分析以及從中得出的結論。

examples.source: The contract and all terms thereof must be signed by both parties.
examples.target: 合約及其所有條款必須由雙方簽署。

examples.source: The company failed to pay the tax and the penalties thereof.
examples.target: 該公司未能繳付稅款及其相關罰款。

examples.source: The building is historic, and the preservation thereof is very important.
examples.target: 這座建築具有歷史價值，對其進行保育十分重要。

examples.source: Thermal clothing keeps people warm during cold winter days.
examples.target: 保暖衣物能讓人在寒冷的冬天保持溫暖。

examples.source: The thermal springs in the mountains are very popular with local tourists.
examples.target: 山上的溫泉非常受本地遊客歡迎。

examples.source: This thermal flask can keep coffee hot for several hours.
examples.target: 這個保溫瓶可以讓咖啡保持熱騰騰好幾個小時。

thermostat.meaning: 恆溫器 / 溫度調節器

examples.source: The thermostat controls the temperature in the classroom.
examples.target: 恆溫器控制課室內的溫度。

examples.source: I adjusted the thermostat to keep our living room at a comfortable temperature.
examples.target: 我調整了恆溫器，好讓客廳保持在舒適的溫度。

examples.source: The thermostat is broken, so the air conditioner will not turn on now.
examples.target: 恆溫器壞了，所以冷氣機現在無法啟動。

examples.source: I used a thesaurus to find a better word for my essay.
examples.target: 我用同義詞詞典為我的文章找一個更合適的詞。

examples.source: A thesaurus can help writers find words with similar meanings.
examples.target: 同義詞詞典可以幫助寫作者尋找意思相近的詞語。

examples.source: Our school library has a digital thesaurus for students to use.
examples.target: 我們學校圖書館提供電子同義詞詞典供學生使用。

examples.source: The sauce will thicken after a few minutes of cooking.
examples.target: 醬汁煮幾分鐘後會變得濃稠。

examples.source: The fog began to thicken as we drove up the mountain road.
examples.target: 當我們開車上山時，霧氣開始變得越來越濃。

examples.source: The artist used extra paint to thicken the texture of the painting.
examples.target: 這位藝術家用額外的顏料，讓畫作的質感變得更厚實。

examples.source: Cornstarch is a common thickener used to improve the texture of sauces.
examples.target: 粟粉是一種常用來改善醬汁濃稠度的增稠劑。

examples.source: The label shows that the food contains a natural thickener.
examples.target: 標籤顯示這種食物含有天然增稠劑。

examples.source: The chef added a natural thickener to the soup to give it a richer consistency.
examples.target: 廚師在湯裡加入了一種天然增稠劑，令口感更濃郁。

examples.source: The chef added some cornstarch to the sauce for thickening.
examples.target: 廚師在醬汁中加入了一些粟粉來增稠。

examples.source: You can notice the thickening of the clouds as the storm approaches.
examples.target: 隨著暴風雨逼近，你可以留意到雲層正在變厚。

examples.source: Constant friction caused a noticeable thickening of the skin on his palms.
examples.target: 長期的摩擦導致他手掌上的皮膚明顯變厚。

examples.source: The security guard caught the man in the act of thieving.
examples.target: 保安員當場捉住那個正在偷竊的人。

examples.source: The shop owner installed cameras to put an end to the constant thieving.
examples.target: 店主安裝了攝錄機，以杜絕持續不斷的偷竊行為。

examples.source: He was arrested and charged with petty thieving.
examples.target: 他因犯下小額偷竊罪而被捕及起訴。

examples.source: He felt a sharp pain in his thigh after the race.
examples.target: 比賽結束後，他感到大腿一陣劇痛。

examples.source: The sports diagram shows the main muscles in the thigh.
examples.target: 這幅運動圖解顯示了大腿的主要肌肉。

examples.source: The football player wore a support band around his thigh.
examples.target: 那名足球員在大腿上戴了支撐帶。

examples.source: My history teacher is a deep thinker who loves to discuss new ideas.
examples.target: 我的歷史老師是一位深思熟慮的思想家，很喜歡討論新觀點。

examples.source: She is a creative thinker and always finds unique solutions to difficult problems.
examples.target: 她是一位有創意的思考者，總能為難題找到獨特的解決方法。

examples.source: The club invites every independent thinker to share their opinions on the topic.
examples.target: 學會邀請每一位獨立思考者就這個題目分享他們的意見。

examples.source: The butter was spread thinly over the slice of toast.
examples.target: 牛油被薄薄地塗在那片吐司上。

examples.source: The fabric is woven thinly, so it feels light and soft.
examples.target: 這種布料織得很薄，所以感覺輕柔。

examples.source: The soup was thinly flavoured and needed more seasoning.
examples.target: 這碗湯味道很淡，需要更多調味。

examples.source: Firstly, we need a plan; secondly, money; thirdly, time.
examples.target: 首先，我們需要計劃；其次，需要資金；第三，需要時間。

examples.source: Thirdly, the report explains how the new rule affects students.
examples.target: 第三，報告解釋了新規則如何影響學生。

examples.source: We chose this hotel because it is cheap, clean, and thirdly, near the station.
examples.target: 我們選擇這間酒店，因為它便宜、乾淨，而且第三，它靠近車站。

examples.source: I drank a glass of water to quench my thirst.
examples.target: 我喝了一杯水來解渴。

examples.source: The runner felt a great thirst after the long race.
examples.target: 長跑過後，那位跑手感到非常口渴。

examples.source: She has a thirst for knowledge about space and stars.
examples.target: 她對太空和星星的知識充滿渴望。

examples.source: The donkey was happily chewing on a prickly thistle in the field.
examples.target: 那隻驢子正在田野裡開心地咀嚼著一株多刺的薊。

examples.source: A single thistle had managed to grow through the cracks in the pavement.
examples.target: 有一株薊竟然穿過行人路上的裂縫生長了出來。

examples.source: Many thistles were hidden in the long grass near the path.
examples.target: 小路旁的長草中藏著許多薊。

examples.source: The thoroughbred raced across the track at incredible speed.
examples.target: 這匹純種馬以驚人的速度在跑道上奔馳。

examples.source: Only a true thoroughbred could win such a challenging competition.
examples.target: 只有真正的純種馬才能贏得如此具挑戰性的比賽。

examples.source: The farm specializes in breeding high-quality thoroughbreds.
examples.target: 這家農場專門培育優質的純種馬。

examples.source: She paused thoughtfully before answering the difficult question.
examples.target: 她深思地停頓了一下，才回答那個難題。

examples.source: He thoughtfully brought me a cup of hot tea when I was working late.
examples.target: 當我工作到很晚時，他體貼地為我端來一杯熱茶。

examples.source: The architect thoughtfully designed the building to be accessible for everyone.
examples.target: 建築師體貼地設計了這座建築，確保所有人都能方便出入。

thoughtless.meaning: 欠考慮的 / 不顧他人的

examples.source: It was very thoughtless of him to forget his best friend's birthday party.
examples.target: 他忘記了最好朋友的生日派對，真是太不顧他人感受了。

examples.source: Thoughtless comments can hurt classmates even when they sound small.
examples.target: 欠考慮的說話即使聽起來很小事，也可能傷害同學。

examples.source: She realized her thoughtless behavior had caused a lot of trouble for everyone.
examples.target: 她意識到自己欠考慮的行為已經給每個人帶來了許多麻煩。

thoughtlessly.meaning: 不顧他人地 / 欠考慮地

examples.source: He spoke thoughtlessly and hurt his best friend's feelings during the lunch break.
examples.target: 他在午飯時間說話欠考慮，傷害了最好的朋友。

examples.source: The comment was made thoughtlessly during the group project.
examples.target: 那句說話是在小組習作期間欠考慮地說出來的。

examples.source: She thoughtlessly left her bag on the bus and lost all her notes.
examples.target: 她一時大意把書包遺留在巴士上，弄丟了所有筆記。

examples.source: The waves continued to thrash against the side of the small boat.
examples.target: 海浪不斷地猛烈拍打著小船的側面。

examples.source: Our school team managed to thrash their opponents in the final match.
examples.target: 我們校隊在決賽中大勝對手。

examples.source: The branches thrashed against the window during the storm.
examples.target: 暴風雨期間，樹枝猛烈拍打著窗戶。

examples.source: The dog barked in a threatening way when I walked past the gate.
examples.target: 當我經過門口時，那隻狗發出了帶威脅性的叫聲。

examples.source: He received a threatening message from an unknown number on his mobile phone.
examples.target: 他的手機收到了一則來自陌生號碼的威脅性訊息。

examples.source: The dark clouds looked threatening, so the picnic was moved indoors.
examples.target: 烏雲看起來帶威脅性，所以野餐改在室內進行。

examples.source: The poem repeats the same line thrice for emphasis.
examples.target: 這首詩把同一句重複三次，以作強調。

examples.source: The athlete has won this championship thrice in a row.
examples.target: 這位運動員已經連續三次贏得這項錦標賽。

examples.source: I have checked the report thrice to ensure there are no mistakes.
examples.target: 我已經檢查了這份報告三次，確保沒有任何錯誤。

thrift.meaning: 買二手貨 / 節儉購物

examples.source: Many students choose to thrift their clothes to save money and find unique styles.
examples.target: 很多學生選擇買二手衣服，既省錢又能找到獨特的風格。

examples.source: I love to thrift for vintage furniture at local charity shops on weekends.
examples.target: 我週末喜歡去慈善商店尋找二手復古家具。

examples.source: Thrifting has become a popular way for young people to shop more sustainably.
examples.target: 購買二手貨已成為年輕人實踐可持續消費的一種熱門方式。

examples.source: Despite a difficult start, she became a true thriver at school.
examples.target: 儘管起步艱難，她在學校成為一位能在逆境中茁壯成長的人。

examples.source: The programme helps every student become a thriver regardless of their background.
examples.target: 這個計劃幫助每位學生無論背景如何，都能在逆境中茁壯成長。

examples.source: He is a natural thriver who turns challenges into opportunities for growth.
examples.target: 他天生就是個能在逆境中茁壯成長的人，懂得把挑戰轉化為成長機會。

examples.source: My finger began to throb after I bumped it on the desk.
examples.target: 我的手指撞到書桌後開始抽痛。

examples.source: She felt her head throb because she had been staring at the screen for too long.
examples.target: 她因為盯著螢幕太久，感到頭部一陣陣地抽痛。

examples.source: The music made the floor throb gently under our feet.
examples.target: 音樂令我們腳下的地板微微震動。

examples.source: The young prince will soon sit on the throne to lead the country.
examples.target: 那位年輕王子很快就會登上王位，帶領這個國家。

examples.source: The king decided to give up his throne after ruling for many years.
examples.target: 國王在統治多年後，決定放棄他的王位。

examples.source: We saw a beautiful golden throne in the middle of the old palace.
examples.target: 我們在舊宮殿中央看到了一個美麗的金色寶座。

throwaway.meaning: 用完即棄的 / 隨口說的

examples.source: The school is reducing its use of throwaway plastic cutlery.
examples.target: 學校正在減少使用即棄塑膠餐具。

examples.source: It was just a throwaway remark, so no one discussed it for long.
examples.target: 那只是一句隨口說的話，所以沒有人討論太久。

examples.source: The company produces too many throwaway items that end up in landfills.
examples.target: 這間公司生產了太多最終會被送往堆填區的即棄產品。

examples.source: The javelin thrower practiced hard every day to prepare for the school sports day.
examples.target: 那位標槍投擲者每天努力練習，為學校運動會做好準備。

examples.source: Our team needs a strong discus thrower to win the upcoming inter-school competition.
examples.target: 我們隊伍需要一位強力的鐵餅投擲者，才能贏得即將到來的校際比賽。

examples.source: As an experienced hammer thrower, he taught the beginners how to hold the equipment.
examples.target: 作為一名經驗豐富的鏈球投擲者，他教導初學者如何握住器材。

examples.source: The chef thrust a plate of food into my hands during the busy lunch hour.
examples.target: 午餐繁忙時，廚師猛地將一碟食物遞到我手上。

examples.source: He tried to thrust the heavy door open with his shoulder.
examples.target: 他試圖用肩膀猛力推開那扇沉重的大門。

examples.source: She thrust the envelope into the drawer before leaving the room.
examples.target: 她離開房間前，把信封猛地塞進抽屜。

examples.source: The spacecraft fired its main thruster to adjust its trajectory.
examples.target: 太空船啟動了主推進器來調整飛行軌道。

examples.source: Engineers are testing a new type of ion thruster for long-distance space travel.
examples.target: 工程師們正在測試一種用於長途太空旅行的新型離子推進器。

examples.source: If the steering thruster fails, the ship will be difficult to maneuver.
examples.target: 如果轉向推進器失靈，這艘船將難以操縱。

thud.meaning: 砰的一聲 / 重物落地聲

examples.source: The heavy textbook fell onto the floor with a loud thud.
examples.target: 那本厚重的課本掉在地上，發出砰的一聲。

examples.source: I heard a soft thud when my bag hit the ground.
examples.target: 當我的書包掉到地上時，我聽到了一聲悶響。

examples.source: The box landed with a thud after falling off the shelf.
examples.target: 箱子從架子上掉下來，發出了砰的一聲。

examples.source: The report described the man as a local thug with a long record of causing trouble.
examples.target: 報道形容那名男子是一名經常滋事的本地暴徒。

examples.source: The movie features a group of thugs who cause problems in the neighbourhood.
examples.target: 這部電影講述了一群暴徒在社區中製造麻煩的故事。

examples.source: People felt uneasy when a group of thugs gathered near the station.
examples.target: 當一群暴徒聚集在車站附近時，人們感到不安。

examples.source: Every ticketholder must show their pass at the main entrance.
examples.target: 每位持票人都必須在正門出示通行證。

examples.source: The ticketholder can enter the concert hall ten minutes early.
examples.target: 持票人可以提早十分鐘進入音樂廳。

examples.source: Each ticketholder received a programme before the show started.
examples.target: 每位持票人在表演開始前都收到一份節目表。

examples.source: The tidal patterns change significantly throughout the day at the local beach.
examples.target: 本地海灘的潮汐規律在一天內會有明顯的變化。

examples.source: The tidal forecast helped the boat team plan the trip.
examples.target: 潮汐預報幫助船隊安排旅程。

examples.source: Strong tidal currents can be dangerous near the rocky coast.
examples.target: 岩岸附近的強勁潮汐水流可能很危險。

examples.source: The magazine featured a few interesting tidbits about the actor's daily life.
examples.target: 這本雜誌刊登了一些關於那位演員日常生活的小趣聞。

examples.source: The guide shared a small tidbit about the history of the old building.
examples.target: 導遊分享了一則關於那座舊建築歷史的小趣聞。

examples.source: I picked up a useful tidbit of information about the new exam format.
examples.target: 我得知了一則關於新考試模式的實用小資訊。

examples.source: The boat was tied to a post near the pier.
examples.target: 那艘船被綁在碼頭附近的一根柱子上。

examples.source: My success is tied to how hard I study every day.
examples.target: 我的成功與我每天多努力讀書息息相關。

examples.source: His shoelaces were tied before the race began.
examples.target: 比賽開始前，他的鞋帶已經綁好。

examples.source: The stadium has tiered seating so everyone can see the stage clearly.
examples.target: 體育館設有分層座位，讓每個人都能清楚看到舞台。

examples.source: Our school library uses a tiered system to organize books by difficulty.
examples.target: 我們學校圖書館使用分層系統，按難度來整理書籍。

examples.source: The wedding cake had three tiered layers.
examples.target: 那個結婚蛋糕共有三層。

examples.source: The rope became tighter as the bag was pulled closed.
examples.target: 袋子被拉上時，繩子變得更緊。

examples.source: The school has tighter rules about using phones in class.
examples.target: 學校對課堂上使用手機有更嚴格的規定。

examples.source: My shoes feel tighter because I am wearing thick socks.
examples.target: 因為我穿了厚襪子，所以覺得鞋子更緊了。

examples.source: The little girl held her mother's hand tightly in the crowd.
examples.target: 小女孩在人群中緊緊地握住媽媽的手。

examples.source: The lid was closed tightly after the experiment.
examples.target: 實驗後，蓋子被蓋得很緊。

examples.source: He hugged his best friend tightly when they met at school.
examples.target: 當他們在學校見面時，他緊緊地擁抱了他的好朋友。

examples.source: The kitchen floor is covered with white ceramic tile.
examples.target: 廚房地板鋪滿了白色的瓷磚。

examples.source: A heavy storm blew a roof tile off the house.
examples.target: 一場大風暴吹走了屋頂的一塊瓦片。

examples.source: The wet bathroom tile looked shiny under the light.
examples.target: 濕了的浴室瓷磚在燈光下顯得閃亮。

examples.source: The tiler is busy installing new tiles in our kitchen this morning.
examples.target: 鋪瓷磚工人今早正忙著在我們的廚房安裝新瓷磚。

examples.source: We hired a professional tiler to fix the broken floor in the bathroom.
examples.target: 我們聘請了一位專業的鋪瓷磚工人來修補浴室破損的地板。

examples.source: My uncle works as a tiler and he is very skilled at his job.
examples.target: 我的叔叔是一名鋪瓷磚工人，他在這份工作上非常熟練。

examples.source: The photo frame began to tilt to one side.
examples.target: 相框開始向一邊傾斜。

examples.source: The heavy rain caused the old tree to tilt slightly.
examples.target: 大雨令那棵老樹稍微傾斜了。

examples.source: The bottle will pour out water if it tilts too far.
examples.target: 如果瓶子傾斜得太多，水就會倒出來。

examples.source: The timekeeper blew the whistle to signal the end of the basketball match.
examples.target: 計時員吹響哨子，示意籃球比賽結束。

examples.source: Our teacher asked me to be the timekeeper for the group presentation today.
examples.target: 老師叫我擔任今天小組匯報的計時員。

examples.source: The timekeeper recorded the length of every student speech.
examples.target: 計時員記錄了每位同學演講的時間。

timeless.meaning: 永恆的 / 不受時間影響的

examples.source: This simple black dress is a timeless piece for any formal occasion.
examples.target: 這條簡單的黑色連身裙是適合任何正式場合的永恆經典。

examples.source: The beauty of the sunset is timeless and always makes me feel calm.
examples.target: 日落的美景是永恆的，總能令我感到平靜。

examples.source: He enjoys reading timeless stories that people have loved for many years.
examples.target: 他喜歡閱讀那些多年來一直深受大眾喜愛的永恆故事。

examples.source: The teacher called a timeout to help the students calm down after recess.
examples.target: 老師叫大家暫停一下，讓學生在小息後平靜下來。

examples.source: Our basketball team requested a timeout to discuss a new strategy.
examples.target: 我們的籃球隊要求暫停，以便商討新的策略。

examples.source: A short timeout helped the class restart the activity calmly.
examples.target: 短暫的休息時間幫助全班平靜地重新開始活動。

examples.source: We need a realistic timescale to finish this group project on time.
examples.target: 我們需要一個切合實際的時間表，才能準時完成這個小組習作。

examples.source: The teacher gave us a clear timescale for completing our history essay.
examples.target: 老師給了我們一個清晰的時間表，讓我們完成歷史論文。

examples.source: It is hard to set a fixed timescale for learning a language.
examples.target: 要為學習一門語言設定一個固定的所需時間是很困難的。

examples.source: The timid student was too nervous to answer the teacher's question in class.
examples.target: 那位膽小的學生太緊張了，不敢在課堂上回答老師的問題。

examples.source: She is a bit timid and feels shy when meeting new people at school.
examples.target: 她性格比較膽小，在學校遇到新朋友時會感到害羞。

examples.source: The timid kitten hid behind the chair when visitors arrived.
examples.target: 有客人到訪時，那隻膽小的小貓躲在椅子後面。

examples.source: He spent the whole afternoon tinkering with his old bicycle.
examples.target: 他花了一整個下午去擺弄他那輛舊單車。

examples.source: She likes to tinker with computer settings to make them work better.
examples.target: 她喜歡擺弄電腦設定，好讓它們運作得更順暢。

examples.source: The mechanic is tinkering with the engine to fix the noise.
examples.target: 技工正在修補引擎，以解決那個噪音問題。

examples.source: We often eat tinned fish when we go camping.
examples.target: 我們去露營時，經常會吃罐頭魚。

examples.source: The supermarket shelf was full of tinned soup.
examples.target: 超級市場的貨架上放滿了罐頭湯。

examples.source: I prefer fresh fruit instead of tinned fruit.
examples.target: 比起罐頭水果，我更喜歡新鮮水果。

examples.source: Tinnitus is a ringing or buzzing sound heard in the ears.
examples.target: 耳鳴是耳中聽到的鈴聲或嗡嗡聲。

examples.source: The health leaflet explains what tinnitus can feel like.
examples.target: 這份健康單張解釋了耳鳴可能帶來的感覺。

examples.source: A quiet room can make tinnitus seem more noticeable to some people.
examples.target: 安靜的房間可能會令某些人更明顯地感到耳鳴。

examples.source: The car windows are tinted to keep the inside cool during summer.
examples.target: 這輛車的車窗貼了隔熱膜，好讓車廂在夏天保持涼爽。

examples.source: She wears tinted glasses to protect her eyes from the bright sunlight.
examples.target: 她戴著有色眼鏡，以保護眼睛免受強烈陽光的照射。

examples.source: These tinted lenses help me see more clearly on very sunny days.
examples.target: 這些有色鏡片讓我在陽光猛烈的日子裡看得更清楚。

examples.source: The manager went on a long tirade about the team's poor performance.
examples.target: 經理針對團隊表現不佳，發表了一番長篇怒斥。

examples.source: She ignored his angry tirade and calmly walked out of the room.
examples.target: 她無視他那番長篇怒斥，冷靜地走出了房間。

examples.source: After the coach's tirade, the players were more focused during practice.
examples.target: 在教練那番長篇怒斥之後，球員們在練習時變得更加專注。

examples.source: Our tireless coach works hard to help us improve our basketball skills.
examples.target: 我們那位不知疲倦的教練努力協助我們提升籃球技巧。

examples.source: She is a tireless volunteer who spends every weekend helping elderly people.
examples.target: 她是一位不知疲倦的義工，每個週末都花時間幫助長者。

examples.source: The tireless rescue team continued working after sunset.
examples.target: 那支不知疲倦的救援隊在日落後仍繼續工作。

examples.source: The volunteers worked tirelessly to clean up the park after the big event.
examples.target: 大型活動結束後，義工們不知疲倦地清理公園。

examples.source: She studied tirelessly for weeks to prepare for her final school examinations.
examples.target: 為了準備學校期末考試，她連續幾個星期不知疲倦地溫習。

examples.source: Our teachers work tirelessly every day to support their students.
examples.target: 我們的老師每天都不知疲倦地工作，支援學生。

examples.source: She spent an hour titivating her hair before the school dance.
examples.target: 舞會開始前，她花了一小時來修飾自己的髮型。

examples.source: The author is still titivating the final chapter of her novel.
examples.target: 那位作家仍在反覆修改她小說的最後一章。

examples.source: He was busy titivating his presentation slides to make them look more professional.
examples.target: 他正忙著修飾簡報投影片，好讓它們看起來更專業。

titular.meaning: 標題中的 / 名義上的

examples.source: The titular character of the novel is a young detective solving mysteries.
examples.target: 這部小說的同名主角是一位正在偵破懸案的年輕偵探。

examples.source: He is the titular head of the company, but he has no real power to make decisions.
examples.target: 他是這家公司的名義負責人，但並沒有實權去作決定。

examples.source: The film's titular song became a massive hit across the city.
examples.target: 這部電影的同名主題曲在全城爆紅。

toiletries.meaning: 洗漱用品 / 個人護理用品

examples.source: The students packed their toiletries before leaving for the school trip.
examples.target: 學生出發去學校旅行前收拾好洗漱用品。

examples.source: I bought some new toiletries because I ran out of shampoo.
examples.target: 因為我的洗頭水用完了，所以我買了一些新的個人護理用品。

examples.source: The hotel provides free toiletries for guests in every bathroom.
examples.target: 酒店在每間浴室都為住客提供免費的洗漱用品。

tolerable.meaning: 可忍受的 / 尚可接受的

examples.source: The noise from the construction site is barely tolerable during my study hours.
examples.target: 在我溫習的時候，地盤傳來的噪音勉強還可以忍受。

examples.source: Although the coffee was a bit bitter, it was still quite tolerable today.
examples.target: 雖然今天的咖啡有點苦，但味道尚算可以接受。

examples.source: The weather is tolerable today, so we can go for a short walk.
examples.target: 今天的天氣尚算舒適，我們可以在附近散散步。

examples.source: A tolerant person respects people who have different opinions.
examples.target: 寬容的人會尊重持不同意見的人。

examples.source: Teachers are usually tolerant when students make small mistakes in their homework.
examples.target: 當學生在功課上犯小錯時，老師通常都很寬容。

examples.source: A tolerant classroom feels safer for open discussion.
examples.target: 寬容的課室氣氛會令公開討論更有安全感。

examples.source: The optometrist used a tonometer to measure the pressure inside my eyes.
examples.target: 視光師用眼壓計來測量我眼睛內部的壓力。

examples.source: A tonometer is a tool used during some eye examinations.
examples.target: 眼壓計是在某些眼睛檢查中使用的工具。

examples.source: Modern tonometers can take measurements quickly.
examples.target: 現代眼壓計能快速完成量度。

topical.meaning: 熱門話題的 / 時事性的

examples.source: Climate change remains a highly topical issue for students nowadays.
examples.target: 氣候變化仍然是現時學生非常關注的熱門話題。

examples.source: The magazine features several topical articles about the impact of artificial intelligence.
examples.target: 這本雜誌刊登了幾篇關於人工智能影響的時事文章。

examples.source: We held a debate on a topical subject that affects our local community.
examples.target: 我們就一個影響本地社區的熱門議題進行了辯論。

topping.meaning: 配料 / 灑在食物上的材料

examples.source: You can choose your favorite topping for the ice cream.
examples.target: 你可以為雪糕選擇你最喜歡的配料。

examples.source: The pizza has extra cheese as a delicious topping.
examples.target: 這款薄餅加了額外的芝士作為美味的配料。

examples.source: I like adding fresh fruit as a topping on yogurt.
examples.target: 我喜歡在乳酪上加些新鮮水果作為配料。

examples.source: The strong wind caused the old tree to topple over onto the road.
examples.target: 強風把那棵老樹吹倒在馬路上。

examples.source: The stack of books began to topple on the messy desk.
examples.target: 亂糟糟的書桌上，那疊書開始倒下。

examples.source: The heavy boxes began to topple when they were moved too quickly.
examples.target: 那些重箱子被移動得太快時，開始翻倒。

examples.source: The dancer started his performance with some smooth toprock moves on stage.
examples.target: 那位舞者以幾個流暢的站立舞步開始了他的舞台表演。

examples.source: Toprock is often performed at the start of a breakdance routine.
examples.target: 站立舞步通常會在霹靂舞表演開始時出現。

examples.source: Learning basic toprock helps new breakdancers build rhythm.
examples.target: 學習基本站立舞步有助街舞初學者建立節奏感。

examples.source: Waiting for the exam results was a constant torment for the students.
examples.target: 等待考試結果對學生來說是一種持續的折磨。

examples.source: He suffered the torment of regret after making that mistake.
examples.target: 犯下那個錯誤後，他飽受後悔的折磨。

examples.source: The loud construction noise outside was a real torment to everyone in the office.
examples.target: 外面嘈雜的施工噪音對辦公室裡的每個人來說都是一種折磨。

examples.source: The news reported that a tornado formed near the small town yesterday.
examples.target: 新聞報導昨天有一個龍捲風在那個小鎮附近形成。

examples.source: We learned how a tornado forms during our geography lesson this morning.
examples.target: 我們在今早的地理課上學習了龍捲風是如何形成的。

examples.source: The weather chart showed a tornado warning in the area.
examples.target: 天氣圖顯示該區有龍捲風警報。

examples.source: The museum displays an old torpedo from a naval history exhibition.
examples.target: 博物館在海軍歷史展覽中展出了一枚舊魚雷。

examples.source: A torpedo is a weapon that travels underwater.
examples.target: 魚雷是一種在水底前進的武器。

examples.source: The textbook shows a diagram of a torpedo beside a submarine.
examples.target: 課本在潛艇旁展示了一幅魚雷圖解。

examples.source: The heavy rain turned the small stream into a fast torrent.
examples.target: 大雨將小溪變成了急流。

examples.source: She faced a torrent of questions from the reporters after the press conference.
examples.target: 記者會在結束後，她面對著記者們的一連串提問。

examples.source: The mountain river became a powerful torrent after the storm.
examples.target: 暴風雨過後，山間的河流變成了洶湧的洪流。

examples.source: The match was cancelled due to the torrential rain.
examples.target: 由於傾盆大雨，比賽被迫取消。

examples.source: We stayed indoors to avoid the torrential downpour.
examples.target: 我們留在室內，以避開猛烈的暴雨。

examples.source: The streets were flooded after hours of torrential rain.
examples.target: 經過數小時的傾盆大雨後，街道都水浸了。

examples.source: I carry my textbooks in a sturdy canvas tote to school.
examples.target: 我把教科書放在一個結實的帆布手提袋裡帶回學校。

examples.source: Her tote was large enough for a notebook and a water bottle.
examples.target: 她的手提袋夠大，可以放下一本筆記簿和一個水壺。

examples.source: The library gave each student a simple tote for carrying books.
examples.target: 圖書館給每位學生一個簡單的手提袋來裝書。

examples.source: The toucan has a very large and colourful beak for eating fruit.
examples.target: 巨嘴鳥擁有一個非常大且色彩鮮豔的鳥喙，用來吃水果。

examples.source: We saw a beautiful toucan sitting on a branch at the zoo.
examples.target: 我們在動物園看到一隻漂亮的巨嘴鳥正停在樹枝上。

examples.source: The toucan is famous for its bright feathers and unique appearance.
examples.target: 巨嘴鳥以其鮮豔的羽毛和獨特的外表而聞名。

examples.source: His failed business is a touchy topic for the family.
examples.target: 他生意失敗的事是家人之間一個敏感話題。

examples.source: She has been a bit touchy lately because of the heavy workload.
examples.target: 因為工作量太大，她最近變得有點易怒。

examples.source: Politics is a touchy subject, so the group changed the topic.
examples.target: 政治是一個敏感的話題，所以小組轉換了話題。

examples.source: Regular exercise can help to toughen muscles over time.
examples.target: 恆常運動可以隨著時間鍛鍊肌肉，使其變得更強壯。

examples.source: The experience helped to toughen her character.
examples.target: 這次經歷磨練了她的性格，使她變得更堅強。

examples.source: The government plans to toughen the laws against littering.
examples.target: 政府計劃加強針對亂拋垃圾的法例。

tougher.meaning: 更艱難的 / 更強硬的

examples.source: The final exam was much tougher than the practice papers we did yesterday.
examples.target: 這次期末考試比我們昨天做的練習卷艱難得多。

examples.source: The new rules are tougher than the old ones.
examples.target: 新規則比舊規則更嚴格。

examples.source: Life in the city is tougher when people have to work and study at the same time.
examples.target: 當人們需要同時兼顧工作和學業時，城市生活會變得更艱難。

examples.source: The band is currently touring across Europe to promote their latest music album.
examples.target: 這支樂隊目前正在歐洲巡迴演出，以宣傳他們最新的音樂專輯。

examples.source: She enjoys touring local museums and galleries during her summer school holidays.
examples.target: 她很享受在暑假期間到處參觀本地的博物館和畫廊。

examples.source: The famous theatre group is touring the country with their new stage play.
examples.target: 這個著名的劇團正帶著他們的新舞台劇在全國巡迴演出。

touristic.meaning: 遊客常去的 / 旅遊化的

examples.source: We decided to avoid the most touristic areas of the city to experience the local culture.
examples.target: 我們決定避開市內遊客最常去的地方，以體驗地道文化。

examples.source: The old town has become too touristic and lost much of its original charm.
examples.target: 這座舊城區變得太過旅遊化，失去了不少原有的魅力。

examples.source: It is hard to find authentic food in such a touristic part of the island.
examples.target: 在島上這麼遊客化的區域，很難找到地道的食物。

examples.source: The salesman was touting the new smartphone as the best model on the market.
examples.target: 推銷員不斷吹捧這款新智能手機是市面上最好的型號。

examples.source: Many travel websites tout this small island as a hidden paradise for tourists.
examples.target: 許多旅遊網站都大力宣傳這個小島是遊客眼中的隱世天堂。

examples.source: The brochure touts the school programme as creative and practical.
examples.target: 這本小冊子宣傳該學校課程具創意而且實用。

examples.source: The breakdown truck arrived to tow my car to the nearest garage.
examples.target: 拖車到達現場，把我的車拖回附近的車房。

examples.source: The boat was towed back to the harbour after the engine failed.
examples.target: 引擎故障後，那艘船被拖回港口。

examples.source: The small cart can tow light equipment across the field.
examples.target: 這輛小車可以在田野上拖行輕型器材。

examples.source: Some plants produce a toxin to protect themselves from insects.
examples.target: 有些植物會產生毒素來保護自己免受昆蟲侵害。

examples.source: The scientist is studying how this specific toxin affects cells.
examples.target: 科學家正在研究這種特定的毒素如何影響細胞。

examples.source: The report explains why the toxin must be handled carefully in the laboratory.
examples.target: 報告解釋了為何這種毒素在實驗室內必須小心處理。

examples.source: I attached a small GPS tracker to my bag so I can find it.
examples.target: 我在書包上掛了一個小型 GPS 追蹤器，方便尋找。

examples.source: The fitness tracker on my wrist records how many steps I walk daily.
examples.target: 我手腕上的運動追蹤器會記錄我每天走了多少步。

examples.source: Our teacher used a flight tracker to see where the plane was landing.
examples.target: 老師用了航班追蹤器來查看飛機在哪裡降落。

tract.meaning: 道 / 管道 / 大片土地

examples.source: The digestive tract is responsible for breaking down the food we eat.
examples.target: 消化道負責分解我們進食的食物。

examples.source: The developer bought a large tract of land to build a new housing estate.
examples.target: 發展商買入了一大片土地，用來興建新的屋苑。

examples.source: The respiratory tract can be irritated by air pollution.
examples.target: 呼吸道可能會受到空氣污染刺激。

examples.source: The car struggled to gain traction on the icy road.
examples.target: 汽車在結冰路面上很難獲得牽引力。

examples.source: The new campaign is finally gaining traction among young people.
examples.target: 這個新的宣傳活動終於在年輕人之間取得進展。

examples.source: Good tyres provide better traction in wet weather.
examples.target: 優質輪胎在潮濕天氣下可以提供更好的牽引力。

examples.source: The farmer uses a tractor to plow his large field.
examples.target: 農夫用拖拉機來耕種他的大片田地。

examples.source: My uncle drives a big tractor on his farm every day.
examples.target: 我叔叔每天都在農場駕駛一輛大拖拉機。

examples.source: We saw a red tractor when we visited the countryside.
examples.target: 當我們去鄉村參觀時，我們看到了一輛紅色的拖拉機。

examples.source: These rare stamps are highly tradeable among collectors.
examples.target: 這些珍稀郵票在收藏家之間非常容易交易。

examples.source: The game card is tradeable, so players can exchange it with others.
examples.target: 這張遊戲卡是可交易的，所以玩家可以和其他人交換。

examples.source: The platform lists which digital items are tradeable.
examples.target: 平台列出哪些數碼物品是可交易的。

examples.source: The local trader sells fresh fruits and vegetables at the morning market.
examples.target: 那位本地商人在早市售賣新鮮的蔬果。

examples.source: My uncle is a trader who works in the financial district.
examples.target: 我叔叔是一位在金融區工作的交易員。

examples.source: Every trader records the details of their daily business.
examples.target: 每一位商人都會記錄日常生意的資料。

examples.source: The local tradesman repaired our broken window in less than an hour.
examples.target: 那位本地工匠在不到一小時內修好了我們破掉的窗戶。

examples.source: He is a skilled tradesman who has worked in the furniture industry for decades.
examples.target: 他是一位技術精湛的工匠，在家具行業工作了幾十年。

examples.source: A reliable tradesman can help repair an old apartment.
examples.target: 可靠的師傅可以協助修理舊公寓。

examples.source: Traditionally, Hong Kong students wear their school uniforms on school days.
examples.target: 傳統上，香港學生在上課日會穿著校服。

examples.source: People traditionally eat mooncakes during the Mid-Autumn Festival with their families.
examples.target: 人們傳統上會在中秋節與家人一起吃月餅。

examples.source: We traditionally visit our grandparents during the Lunar New Year holidays.
examples.target: 我們傳統上會在農曆新年假期探望祖父母。

examples.source: The report discusses the illegal trafficking of rare animals.
examples.target: 報告討論了珍稀動物的非法販運活動。

examples.source: International laws help prevent the trafficking of dangerous and illegal goods.
examples.target: 國際法有助於防止危險及非法貨物的販運。

examples.source: Many countries cooperate to fight against the trafficking of prohibited items across borders.
examples.target: 許多國家合作打擊跨境違禁品非法販運。

examples.source: The young athlete tragically missed the final race because of an injury.
examples.target: 那位年輕運動員因受傷而不幸錯過決賽。

examples.source: The old library was tragically destroyed in a fire last winter.
examples.target: 那間舊圖書館在去年冬天不幸被大火燒毀。

examples.source: He tragically lost his favourite camera while travelling in the city centre.
examples.target: 他在市中心旅遊時不幸弄丟了最喜歡的相機。

examples.source: She is a true trailblazer in the field of renewable energy.
examples.target: 她是再生能源領域中真正的開拓者。

examples.source: The company is a trailblazer in developing affordable electric cars.
examples.target: 這間公司是研發平價電動車的先驅。

examples.source: He was a trailblazer who paved the way for future generations of scientists.
examples.target: 他是一位先驅，為後世的科學家鋪平了道路。

examples.source: The new trainee is learning how to use the office computer system.
examples.target: 那位新見習人員正在學習如何使用辦公室的電腦系統。

examples.source: Our manager provides extra support to every trainee during their first month here.
examples.target: 我們的經理會在每位受訓者入職的首個月提供額外支援。

examples.source: The trainee asked questions when the task was unclear.
examples.target: 當工作內容不清楚時，那位見習人員提出了問題。

examples.source: We traipsed all over the shopping mall to find the right gift.
examples.target: 為了買到合適的禮物，我們疲憊地在商場裡走來走去。

examples.source: I was too tired to traipse around the city in the hot weather.
examples.target: 天氣炎熱，我累得不想在城裡到處走。

examples.source: She traipsed through the muddy field after the heavy rain.
examples.target: 大雨過後，她疲憊地走過那片泥濘的田野。

examples.source: The company's growth trajectory has been impressive over the last few years.
examples.target: 這家公司過去幾年的發展軌跡令人印象深刻。

examples.source: The rocket followed a curved trajectory into space.
examples.target: 火箭沿著彎曲的軌跡飛向太空。

examples.source: His career trajectory changed after he decided to study abroad.
examples.target: 在他決定出國留學後，他的事業發展軌跡便改變了。

trammelled.meaning: 受束縛的 / 受限制的

examples.source: She felt trammelled by the strict rules of her old school.
examples.target: 她覺得自己受到舊校嚴格校規的束縛。

examples.source: His creativity was trammelled by a lack of resources.
examples.target: 他的創意因缺乏資源而受到限制。

examples.source: The young artist refused to be trammelled by traditional painting styles.
examples.target: 這位年輕藝術家拒絕受傳統繪畫風格所束縛。

examples.source: The crowd began to trample the grass as they rushed toward the stage.
examples.target: 人群衝向舞台時，開始踩踏草地。

examples.source: The heavy boots trampled the soft mud near the path.
examples.target: 厚重的靴子踩踏了小路旁的軟泥。

examples.source: The essay explains how unfair rules can trample personal freedom.
examples.target: 這篇文章解釋了不公平規則如何踐踏個人自由。

trampolining.meaning: 彈床活動 / 蹦床運動

examples.source: Trampolining is a fun way to exercise with friends.
examples.target: 彈床活動是一種與朋友一起運動的有趣方式。

examples.source: We went trampolining at the indoor park during the weekend.
examples.target: 週末期間，我們去了室內遊樂場玩彈床。

examples.source: The school club teaches basic trampolining skills.
examples.target: 學校學會教授基本彈床技巧。

tramway.meaning: 電車路線 / 電車系統

examples.source: The tramway runs through the busy streets of Hong Kong Island.
examples.target: 電車路線穿過香港島繁忙的街道。

examples.source: We took the tramway because it is a cheap way to travel.
examples.target: 我們搭乘電車，因為這是一種便宜的交通方式。

examples.source: The old tramway is part of the city's history.
examples.target: 這條古老的電車系統是城市歷史的一部分。

examples.source: She enjoyed the tranquillity of the garden early in the morning.
examples.target: 她很享受清晨花園裡的寧靜。

examples.source: Living in the countryside offers a sense of tranquillity that is hard to find in the city.
examples.target: 住在鄉郊地區能讓人感受到一種在城市裡難以尋找的平靜。

examples.source: The still lake gave the whole park a feeling of tranquillity.
examples.target: 平靜的湖面為整個公園帶來寧靜的感覺。

examples.source: They took a transatlantic flight from London to New York.
examples.target: 他們搭乘了一班橫跨大西洋的航班，從倫敦飛往紐約。

examples.source: The two countries signed a new transatlantic trade agreement.
examples.target: 兩國簽署了一項新的橫跨大西洋貿易協定。

examples.source: The transatlantic cable allows for high-speed internet connection between the continents.
examples.target: 這條橫跨大西洋的海底電纜實現了兩大洲之間的高速網絡連接。

examples.source: The secretary transcribed the minutes of the meeting from the audio recording.
examples.target: 秘書從錄音中轉錄會議記錄。

examples.source: The student transcribed the interview carefully for the project.
examples.target: 學生為專題研習仔細轉錄了訪問內容。

examples.source: She spent the whole afternoon transcribing her grandfather's old handwritten letters.
examples.target: 她花了一整個下午，把祖父留下的舊手寫信件抄錄下來。

transferable.meaning: 可轉移的 / 可應用到其他工作的

examples.source: Good communication skills are a transferable asset for many future careers.
examples.target: 良好的溝通技巧是可應用到許多未來職業的能力。

examples.source: Students can gain transferable skills by joining school club activities.
examples.target: 學生可以透過參加學會活動獲得可轉移的技能。

examples.source: The teamwork experience from sports is transferable to many workplace situations.
examples.target: 運動中獲得的團隊合作經驗，可以應用到許多工作環境之中。

examples.source: The invention of the internet has had a transformative effect on communication.
examples.target: 互聯網的發明對溝通方式產生了重大改變。

examples.source: She described her year abroad as a transformative experience.
examples.target: 她形容那年的海外生活是一次帶來重大改變的經歷。

examples.source: The new policy aims to bring transformative changes to the local education system.
examples.target: 這項新政策旨在為本地教育制度帶來重大改變。

examples.source: A blood transfusion is a medical procedure used in hospitals.
examples.target: 輸血是在醫院使用的一種醫療程序。

examples.source: The textbook explains how a transfusion is prepared safely.
examples.target: 課本解釋了輸血如何安全地準備。

examples.source: Strict safety checks are part of every blood transfusion process.
examples.target: 嚴格的安全檢查是每個輸血程序的一部分。

examples.source: He apologized sincerely for his minor transgression.
examples.target: 他為自己犯下的小過失誠懇地道歉。

examples.source: The students were punished for their transgression of the school rules.
examples.target: 學生們因違反校規而受到懲罰。

examples.source: The story shows how one small transgression can lead to serious results.
examples.target: 這個故事顯示一個小小的越界行為也可能帶來嚴重後果。

examples.source: The transhumanist believes that technology may help humans overcome biological limitations.
examples.target: 這位超人類主義者相信，科技可能幫助人類克服生理上的限制。

examples.source: Many transhumanists discuss how science could enhance human abilities.
examples.target: 許多超人類主義者討論科學如何可能提升人類能力。

examples.source: She identifies as a transhumanist and studies brain-computer interfaces.
examples.target: 她是一位超人類主義者，並研究腦機介面。

transient.meaning: 短暫的 / 轉瞬即逝的

examples.source: The beauty of a sunset is often transient.
examples.target: 夕陽的美景往往是短暫的。

examples.source: He realized that his fame was merely transient.
examples.target: 他意識到自己的名氣只不過是轉瞬即逝。

examples.source: We experienced a transient feeling of relief after the exam.
examples.target: 考試結束後，我們感受到了一種短暫的輕鬆感。

translatable.meaning: 可轉化的 / 可套用的

examples.source: His experience in the retail industry is highly translatable to a career in marketing.
examples.target: 他在零售業的經驗，非常適合套用到市場營銷的工作上。

examples.source: The skills you learn in this course are translatable to many different jobs.
examples.target: 你在這門課程學到的技能，可以應用在許多不同的工作之中。

examples.source: Not all theories are easily translatable into practical solutions.
examples.target: 並非所有理論都能夠輕易轉化為實際的解決方案。

examples.source: The translator helped us understand the speech in French.
examples.target: 那位翻譯員幫助我們聽懂法語演講。

examples.source: She wants to be a professional translator when she grows up.
examples.target: 她長大後想成為一名專業翻譯員。

examples.source: The translator explained the document in simple Chinese.
examples.target: 翻譯員用簡單中文解釋了這份文件。

examples.source: The curtains are made of a thin, translucent fabric that lets in soft light.
examples.target: 窗簾是用一種薄薄的半透明布料製成的，透進柔和的光線。

examples.source: The jellyfish looked beautiful as it drifted through the water with its translucent body.
examples.target: 水母拖著半透明的身體在水中漂浮，看起來非常漂亮。

examples.source: She held the piece of sea glass up to the sun to admire its translucent color.
examples.target: 她把那塊海玻璃舉向太陽，欣賞它那半透明的色澤。

examples.source: Scientists are researching ways to keep organs transplantable for a longer period.
examples.target: 科學家正在研究讓器官在更長時間內保持可移植的方法。

examples.source: The article explains what makes some tissue samples transplantable.
examples.target: 這篇文章解釋了甚麼因素令某些組織樣本可以移植。

examples.source: Not every tissue sample is transplantable because medical standards are strict.
examples.target: 由於醫療標準嚴格，並非所有組織樣本都適合移植。

examples.source: Organ transplantation is an important topic in modern medicine.
examples.target: 器官移植是現代醫學中的重要課題。

examples.source: Modern medical technology has made some types of transplantation more common.
examples.target: 現代醫療技術令某些移植手術變得較普遍。

examples.source: Scientists are studying how to improve the success rate of kidney transplantation.
examples.target: 科學家正在研究如何提高腎臟移植的成功率。

trapeze.meaning: 空中飛人吊架 / 高空鞦韆

examples.source: The circus performer swung gracefully on the trapeze high above the crowd.
examples.target: 馬戲團表演者在高空鞦韆上輕盈地擺盪。

examples.source: She has trained on the trapeze for years to perfect her aerial routine.
examples.target: 她多年來一直練習高空鞦韆，以完善高空表演。

examples.source: The trapeze artist caught her partner's hands in mid-air.
examples.target: 那位空中飛人在半空中接住了拍檔的雙手。

trappings.meaning: 外在特徵 / 標誌性配套

examples.source: He enjoys the trappings of success, such as a luxury car and a large house.
examples.target: 他很享受成功帶來的外在標誌，例如名車和大屋。

examples.source: She wanted to be a writer without all the trappings of fame.
examples.target: 她只想當作家，而不想要成名後隨之而來的排場。

examples.source: The office was filled with the trappings of a high-powered executive.
examples.target: 這間辦公室擺滿了高層行政人員的標誌性配套。

examples.source: The naughty puppy started to trash the living room while we were out.
examples.target: 我們外出時，那隻頑皮的小狗開始把客廳弄得一團糟。

examples.source: The storm trashed the decorations in the playground.
examples.target: 暴風雨把操場上的裝飾弄得一團糟。

examples.source: The old storage room was trashed after years of careless use.
examples.target: 那間舊儲物室多年來被隨意使用後變得亂七八糟。

examples.source: The online review harshly trashed the new restaurant.
examples.target: 那篇網上評論嚴厲批評了這家新餐廳。

examples.source: He felt hurt when his colleagues trashed his project proposal during the meeting.
examples.target: 當同事在會議上惡意批評他的計劃書時，他感到很受傷。

examples.source: The article trashed the film without discussing its good points.
examples.target: 那篇文章詆毀了這部電影，卻沒有討論它的優點。

traumatic.meaning: 創傷性的 / 令人受創的

examples.source: The story describes a traumatic childhood memory in a gentle way.
examples.target: 這個故事以溫和的方式描寫一段創傷性的童年回憶。

examples.source: The documentary discusses how people recover after traumatic experiences.
examples.target: 這部紀錄片討論人們如何從創傷性經歷後復原。

examples.source: The character avoids talking about the traumatic event in the novel.
examples.target: 小說中的角色避免談及那件創傷性的事件。

traumatize.meaning: 使受創 / 使留下心理創傷

examples.source: The writer shows how harsh words can traumatize a young character.
examples.target: 作者展示了嚴厲說話如何令年輕角色留下心理創傷。

examples.source: The film avoids showing scenes that might traumatize younger viewers.
examples.target: 這部電影避免展示可能令年幼觀眾受創的場面。

examples.source: The article explains why repeated bullying can traumatize students.
examples.target: 這篇文章解釋了為何反覆欺凌可能令學生留下心理創傷。

examples.source: She wrote a fascinating travelogue about her journey across Japan.
examples.target: 她寫了一篇關於日本旅程的精彩遊記。

examples.source: The author's latest travelogue captures the region's culture and landscapes.
examples.target: 這位作者最新的旅遊見聞錄捕捉了該地區的文化與風景。

examples.source: Reading his travelogue helped me learn more about life abroad.
examples.target: 閱讀他的遊記讓我更了解外地生活。

examples.source: The mountain path was treacherously slippery after the heavy rain.
examples.target: 大雨過後，這條山路變得非常濕滑危險。

examples.source: The icy roads made driving treacherously difficult this morning.
examples.target: 今早路面結冰，令駕駛變得極度危險。

examples.source: The path turned treacherously steep near the summit.
examples.target: 接近山頂時，小路變得險峻陡斜。

examples.source: The hikers tread slowly across the wet rocks.
examples.target: 遠足者慢慢踩過濕滑的石頭。

examples.source: The company must tread carefully to avoid further legal issues.
examples.target: 公司必須小心行事，以避免進一步的法律問題。

examples.source: He accidentally trod on my foot while we were dancing.
examples.target: 我們跳舞時，他不小心踩到我的腳。

examples.source: I run on the treadmill for thirty minutes every morning.
examples.target: 我每天早上都會在跑步機上跑三十分鐘。

examples.source: It is raining outside, so I will use the treadmill today.
examples.target: 外面正在下雨，所以我今天會用跑步機。

examples.source: My father likes to watch the news on the treadmill.
examples.target: 我爸爸喜歡在跑步機上邊跑邊看新聞。

examples.source: Treason is a serious crime against one's country.
examples.target: 叛國罪是針對自己國家的嚴重罪行。

examples.source: The history book explains why treason was punished severely in the past.
examples.target: 歷史書解釋了為何叛國罪在過去會受到嚴厲懲罰。

examples.source: Betraying one's country is considered an act of treason.
examples.target: 背叛國家被視為一種叛國行為。

treasurable.meaning: 寶貴的 / 值得珍惜的

examples.source: We spent a treasurable afternoon sharing stories in the park.
examples.target: 我們在公園分享故事，度過了一個寶貴的下午。

examples.source: These old photographs are treasurable memories of my childhood.
examples.target: 這些舊照片是我童年時光中值得珍惜的回憶。

examples.source: The friendship we built during our school years is truly treasurable.
examples.target: 我們在校園時期建立的友誼確實非常珍貴。

examples.source: The school treasurer manages the funds for student club activities.
examples.target: 學校司庫負責管理學生會活動的資金。

examples.source: Our club treasurer will report the balance of our account to everyone.
examples.target: 我們的學會司庫會向大家報告戶口結餘。

examples.source: The treasurer checked whether the club had enough money for the party.
examples.target: 司庫查看學會是否有足夠金錢舉辦派對。

examples.source: My father built a small treehouse in our backyard last summer.
examples.target: 我爸爸去年夏天在後院建了一間小樹屋。

examples.source: We like to read books when we are in the treehouse.
examples.target: 我們喜歡在樹屋裡看書。

examples.source: The children played board games inside the treehouse.
examples.target: 孩子們在樹屋裡玩桌上遊戲。

examples.source: The little bird built its nest high up in the leafy treetop.
examples.target: 那隻小鳥在茂密的樹頂築起了巢。

examples.source: We could see the bright moon shining clearly above the dark treetop.
examples.target: 我們可以看見明亮的月亮在漆黑的樹梢上閃耀。

examples.source: The strong wind blew hard, causing the treetop to sway back and forth.
examples.target: 強風猛烈地吹著，令樹頂前後搖晃。

trek.meaning: 長途跋涉 / 徒步穿越

examples.source: We trekked for hours to reach the mountain top.
examples.target: 我們長途跋涉數小時才到達山頂。

examples.source: They trekked through the forest when the weather was nice.
examples.target: 天氣好的時候，他們徒步穿越了那片森林。

examples.source: A trek across the desert in summer can be extremely tiring.
examples.target: 夏天在沙漠中長途跋涉可能非常累人。

trekker.meaning: 遠足者 / 徒步旅行者

examples.source: The experienced trekker navigated the mountain trail with ease.
examples.target: 這位經驗豐富的遠足者輕鬆地走過山徑。

examples.source: The trekker carried water and a map before starting the journey.
examples.target: 那位徒步旅行者出發前帶備了水和地圖。

examples.source: The local guide warned the trekkers about the sudden change in weather.
examples.target: 當地嚮導提醒各位遠足者天氣會突然轉變。

examples.source: We enjoy trekking in the countryside during the cool autumn.
examples.target: 我們喜歡在涼爽的秋天到郊外遠足。

examples.source: Trekking is a good way to exercise when the weather is nice.
examples.target: 天氣好的時候，徒步旅行是一種很好的運動方式。

examples.source: Comfortable shoes are useful for trekking on rocky paths.
examples.target: 在多石的小路上遠足時，舒適的鞋很有用。

examples.source: Her hands began to tremble when she opened the gift.
examples.target: 當她打開禮物時，她的雙手開始顫抖。

examples.source: The puppy started to tremble because it was very cold.
examples.target: 那隻小狗因為天氣很冷而開始發抖。

examples.source: He felt his legs tremble after running for a long time.
examples.target: 跑了很長一段時間後，他感到雙腿在發抖。

trendsetter.meaning: 潮流引領者 / 帶動潮流的人

examples.source: My sister is a trendsetter who often creates new styles.
examples.target: 我姐姐是一位經常創造新風格的潮流引領者。

examples.source: He became a trendsetter in our school after starting a new dance craze.
examples.target: 他發起新的舞蹈熱潮後，成為了我們學校的潮流引領者。

examples.source: A trendsetter is often willing to try something different.
examples.target: 潮流引領者通常願意嘗試不同的事物。

examples.source: The brand is known for its trendsetting designs in the fashion industry.
examples.target: 這個品牌以其在時裝界引領潮流的設計而聞名。

examples.source: Her trendsetting style influenced many teenagers in Hong Kong.
examples.target: 她引領潮流的風格影響了許多香港青少年。

examples.source: The company launched a trendsetting smartphone that changed mobile design.
examples.target: 這間公司推出了一款引領潮流的智能手機，改變了流動裝置設計。

examples.source: White sneakers are very trendy this year.
examples.target: 白色運動鞋今年非常流行。

examples.source: The shop window displayed several trendy jackets.
examples.target: 店舖櫥窗展示了幾件時髦外套。

examples.source: This cafe is trendy because many young people like its style.
examples.target: 這間咖啡店因為風格受年輕人歡迎，所以很流行。

examples.source: She waited for the exam results with a sense of trepidation.
examples.target: 她懷著不安的心情等待考試成績。

examples.source: He approached the stage with some trepidation before his first public speech.
examples.target: 在第一次公開演講前，他帶著幾分惶恐走上台。

examples.source: Despite her initial trepidation, she decided to accept the new role.
examples.target: 儘管起初感到不安，她還是決定接受這個新角色。

examples.source: He trains every day to prepare for the upcoming school triathlon competition.
examples.target: 他每天都進行訓練，為即將到來的校際三項鐵人賽作準備。

examples.source: Completing a triathlon requires great physical strength and a lot of endurance.
examples.target: 完成一項三項鐵人賽需要極佳的體能和強大的耐力。

examples.source: My brother wants to join a triathlon to challenge his personal limits.
examples.target: 我哥哥想參加三項鐵人賽，藉此挑戰自己的極限。

examples.source: They faced many tribulations during their long journey to the city.
examples.target: 他們在前往城市的漫長旅途中，經歷了許多苦難。

examples.source: She overcame every tribulation with great courage and determination.
examples.target: 她憑著無比的勇氣與決心，克服了每一個艱難的考驗。

examples.source: The athlete's success was the result of years of hard work and personal tribulation.
examples.target: 這位運動員的成功，是多年努力與艱難經歷所換來的成果。

examples.source: Water began to trickle from the broken pipe in the school garden.
examples.target: 水開始從學校花園裡那條破裂的水管中涓涓流出。

examples.source: A few students started to trickle into the classroom after the bell.
examples.target: 鐘聲響過後，幾名學生開始陸陸續續走進課室。

examples.source: Tears continued to trickle down her face as she told the story.
examples.target: 當她講述那個故事時，淚水不斷地從她臉上流下來。

examples.source: This math problem is a bit tricky, so I need help.
examples.target: 這道數學題有點棘手，所以我需要幫忙。

examples.source: It is tricky to explain the rules when everyone is talking.
examples.target: 當每個人都在說話時，要解釋規則是很難處理的。

examples.source: The teacher gave us a tricky question in the exam today.
examples.target: 老師在今天的考試中出了一道棘手的題目。

examples.source: I just finished reading the final book in the fantasy trilogy.
