examples.target: 我剛剛讀完了那套奇幻小說三部曲的最後一本書。

examples.source: The director is planning to release a trilogy of science fiction films.
examples.target: 那位導演正計劃推出一套科幻電影三部曲。

examples.source: My friend lent me the entire trilogy to read over the summer.
examples.target: 朋友借了整套三部曲給我，讓我可以在暑假期間閱讀。

examples.source: The hairdresser trimmed the student's hair before the new school term.
examples.target: 髮型師在新學期前為那名學生修剪頭髮。

examples.source: The gardener used a pair of scissors to trim the messy hedge.
examples.target: 園丁用一把剪刀修剪那叢雜亂的樹籬。

examples.source: Our family decided to trim monthly spending to save more money.
examples.target: 我們一家人決定削減每月開支，以便儲蓄更多金錢。

examples.source: She bought a few cheap trinkets at the night market to take home as souvenirs.
examples.target: 她在夜市買了幾件廉價的小飾物，打算帶回家做紀念品。

examples.source: The old wooden box was filled with various trinkets she had collected over the years.
examples.target: 那個舊木盒裡裝滿了她多年來收集的各種小玩意。

examples.source: He doesn't care about expensive jewelry; he prefers simple trinkets that have sentimental value.
examples.target: 他不介意昂貴的首飾，反而更喜歡那些有紀念意義的小飾物。

triple.meaning: 變成三倍 / 使成三倍

examples.source: The price of these apples will triple if they become rare.
examples.target: 如果這些蘋果變得稀有，價格就會變成三倍。

examples.source: We plan to triple our production to meet the high demand.
examples.target: 我們計劃將產量增加至三倍，以應付龐大的需求。

examples.source: The number of members has tripled since we started the club.
examples.target: 自從我們成立這個學會後，會員人數已經變成了三倍。

examples.source: I set up my tripod to take a clear photo of the sunset.
examples.target: 我架設好三腳架，準備拍一張清晰的日落照片。

examples.source: The camera stayed steady on the tripod during the school video project.
examples.target: 在學校影片製作期間，相機穩穩地放在三腳架上。

examples.source: The photographer used a sturdy tripod to capture the night view.
examples.target: 攝影師用了一個穩固的三腳架拍攝夜景。

trite.meaning: 陳腔濫調的 / 老套的

examples.source: The movie plot was so trite that I could guess the ending in ten minutes.
examples.target: 這部電影的劇情太老套，我十分鐘內就猜到結局。

examples.source: His speech was full of trite remarks about working hard and never giving up.
examples.target: 他的演講充滿了關於努力和永不放棄的陳腔濫調。

examples.source: It is hard to write a love song that does not sound trite.
examples.target: 要寫一首聽起來不老套的情歌並不容易。

examples.source: Scientists use tritium to study how nuclear fusion works.
examples.target: 科學家利用氚來研究核聚變的運作原理。

examples.source: Tritium is a radioactive isotope of hydrogen often used in research.
examples.target: 氚是一種經常用於研究的放射性氫同位素。

examples.source: The textbook explains why tritium is important in some scientific studies.
examples.target: 課本解釋了為何氚在某些科學研究中很重要。

triumphant.meaning: 勝利的 / 得意洋洋的

examples.source: The team gave a triumphant cheer after winning the final match.
examples.target: 球隊在贏得決賽後發出了勝利的歡呼。

examples.source: She returned home with a triumphant smile after passing her difficult exam.
examples.target: 她在通過艱難的考試後，帶著得意洋洋的笑容回到了家。

examples.source: The athlete made a triumphant return to the sport after recovering from his injury.
examples.target: 那位運動員在傷癒後，成功地重返賽場。

triumphantly.meaning: 得意洋洋地 / 勝利地

examples.source: The team captain held the trophy up triumphantly as the crowd cheered.
examples.target: 當觀眾歡呼時，隊長得意洋洋地舉起獎盃。

examples.source: She smiled triumphantly after solving the difficult math problem.
examples.target: 解開那道數學難題後，她得意洋洋地笑了。

examples.source: After weeks of hard work, he walked into the office triumphantly with the signed contract.
examples.target: 經過數週努力，他帶著簽好的合約，勝利地走進辦公室。

examples.source: Our teacher shared some interesting history trivia during the lunch break today.
examples.target: 老師在今天的午休時間分享了一些有趣的歷史冷知識。

examples.source: We played a fun trivia game to test our knowledge about science.
examples.target: 我們玩了一個有趣的冷知識遊戲，來測試我們對科學的認識。

examples.source: He loves reading books filled with weird trivia about animals and plants.
examples.target: 他很喜歡閱讀那些充滿動植物瑣碎知識的書籍。

examples.source: The meeting focused too much on trivial details.
examples.target: 會議花了太多時間討論瑣碎細節。

examples.source: He often worries about trivial details that matter very little.
examples.target: 他經常為一些影響很小的瑣碎細節感到擔憂。

examples.source: It was a trivial mistake in an otherwise excellent essay.
examples.target: 在一篇整體出色的文章中，這只是一個小錯誤。

examples.source: The giant troll in the fantasy movie looked scary and strong.
examples.target: 那部奇幻電影裡的巨魔看起來既可怕又強壯。

examples.source: The story describes a mountain troll guarding an old bridge.
examples.target: 這個故事描寫一隻山地巨魔守著一條古老的橋。

examples.source: The children drew a picture of a friendly troll living in a cave.
examples.target: 孩子們畫了一幅畫，描繪一隻住在洞穴裡的友善巨魔。

examples.source: The talented trombonist played a beautiful solo during the school music concert.
examples.target: 那位才華橫溢的長號手在學校音樂會中演奏了一段優美的獨奏。

examples.source: My brother is a skilled trombonist in the local youth symphony orchestra.
examples.target: 我哥哥是當地青年交響樂團的一位技術純熟的長號手。

examples.source: The jazz band is looking for a new trombonist to join them.
examples.target: 這支爵士樂隊正在尋找一位新的長號手加入他們。

trope.meaning: 常見橋段 / 老套設定

examples.source: The movie relies on the classic trope of a hero saving the world at the last second.
examples.target: 這部電影依賴英雄在最後一刻拯救世界的經典橋段。

examples.source: Many modern mystery stories avoid the trope of an obvious villain.
examples.target: 許多現代懸疑故事都避免使用反派太明顯的老套設定。

examples.source: The story uses the trope of enemies becoming friends to explore forgiveness.
examples.target: 故事運用了敵人變朋友的橋段，藉此探討寬恕。

examples.source: The teacher caught the troublemaker throwing paper balls during quiet study.
examples.target: 老師發現那個搗蛋鬼在安靜自修時扔紙團。

examples.source: Everyone knows he is a troublemaker who loves to start arguments in class.
examples.target: 大家都知道他是個喜歡在課堂上挑起爭端的惹事者。

examples.source: The story shows how the troublemaker slowly learns to behave better.
examples.target: 這個故事展示那名搗蛋鬼如何慢慢學會改善行為。

troubleshoot.meaning: 排查問題 / 找出故障原因

examples.source: My brother helped me troubleshoot the connection issues on my new laptop.
examples.target: 哥哥幫我排查新手提電腦的連線問題。

examples.source: It took the technician an hour to troubleshoot the broken school printer.
examples.target: 技術人員花了一小時來找出學校打印機的故障原因。

examples.source: The team will troubleshoot the software before finishing the project.
examples.target: 團隊會在完成計劃前先排查軟件問題。

troubleshooting.meaning: 故障排除 / 解決技術問題

examples.source: Our IT teacher helped us with troubleshooting the connection issues on our laptops.
examples.target: 我們的電腦老師協助我們排除手提電腦的連線故障。

examples.source: I spent the whole afternoon troubleshooting why my printer was not working properly.
examples.target: 我花了一整個下午解決打印機運作不正常的技術問題。

examples.source: Basic troubleshooting often fixes common problems with a home Wi-Fi connection.
examples.target: 簡單的故障排除通常能解決家中 Wi-Fi 連線的常見問題。

examples.source: The animals gathered around the wooden trough to drink some water.
examples.target: 動物們聚集在木槽邊喝水。

examples.source: After a long period of decline, the economy finally hit a trough last year.
examples.target: 經過長時間的衰退，經濟終於在去年跌至谷底。

examples.source: Business profits reached a trough during the summer months before picking up again.
examples.target: 夏季期間商業利潤跌至低谷，隨後才開始回升。

examples.source: The dance troupe practiced for months before their big show at school.
examples.target: 那個舞蹈團在學校的大型演出前練習了幾個月。

examples.source: A famous circus troupe will visit Hong Kong to perform this summer.
examples.target: 一個著名的馬戲團將於今年夏天到香港進行表演。

examples.source: Our drama troupe needs more students to help with the stage design.
examples.target: 我們的劇團需要更多學生幫忙負責舞台設計。

examples.source: She used a small trowel to plant the flowers in the garden.
examples.target: 她用一把小鏟在花園裡種花。

examples.source: The bricklayer picked up his trowel to spread the mortar.
examples.target: 泥水匠拿起泥刀來抹灰漿。

examples.source: A trowel is useful for digging small holes in soft soil.
examples.target: 小鏟適合在鬆軟泥土中挖小洞。

trudge.meaning: 沉重地走 / 拖著腳步走

examples.source: I trudged home in the heavy rain after school.
examples.target: 放學後，我在大雨中拖著沉重腳步回家。

examples.source: The tired students trudged up the long hill to the campsite.
examples.target: 疲倦的學生們拖著腳步，走上通往營地的長長山坡。

examples.source: We trudged through the deep snow to reach the warm cabin.
examples.target: 我們在厚厚的積雪中艱難地走著，終於到達溫暖的小屋。

examples.source: It is a truism that health is more important than wealth.
examples.target: 健康比財富更重要，這是不言而喻的老生常談。

examples.source: The statement sounded like a truism, but it still reminded the class of an important idea.
examples.target: 這句話聽起來像老生常談，但仍提醒全班一個重要想法。

examples.source: He dismissed the advice as a mere truism that offered no practical help.
examples.target: 他認為這項建議不過是老生常談，對解決問題毫無實際幫助。

truncated.meaning: 被縮短的 / 刪減了的

examples.source: The teacher gave a truncated version of the lecture because time was short.
examples.target: 因為時間不足，老師講了一個縮短版的課堂內容。

examples.source: The article was truncated to fit the limited space in the newspaper.
examples.target: 這篇文章為了遷就報紙有限的版面而被刪減了。

examples.source: The outdoor concert was truncated because of the heavy rain.
examples.target: 由於大雨，戶外音樂會被迫提早結束。

trundle.meaning: 慢慢行駛 / 隆隆地移動

examples.source: The old cart trundled along the narrow cobblestone street.
examples.target: 那輛舊手推車在狹窄的鵝卵石街道上緩緩滾動。

examples.source: A heavy goods train trundled slowly past the station.
examples.target: 一列重型貨運列車隆隆地駛過車站。

examples.source: The tired child trundled his suitcase behind him as he walked to the hotel.
examples.target: 那名疲憊的孩子拖著行李箱，緩緩地走向酒店。

examples.source: The teacher praised the student for her trustworthiness.
examples.target: 老師稱讚那名學生的可靠性。

examples.source: A good news report depends on the trustworthiness of its sources.
examples.target: 一篇好的新聞報道取決於資料來源的可信度。

examples.source: The club chose him as treasurer because of his trustworthiness.
examples.target: 學會因為他的可靠性而選他做司庫。

examples.source: I brought my trusty notebook to every lesson.
examples.target: 我每一課都帶著那本可靠的筆記簿。

examples.source: The old camera is still my trusty tool for school projects.
examples.target: 那部舊相機仍然是我做學校專題時可靠的工具。

examples.source: She repaired the chair with her trusty set of tools.
examples.target: 她用那套可靠的工具修理椅子。

examples.source: A truthful answer is important during a class discussion.
examples.target: 在課堂討論中，誠實的回答很重要。

examples.source: The witness gave a truthful account of what happened.
examples.target: 那名目擊者誠實地講述了事情經過。

examples.source: She is known for being truthful with her friends.
examples.target: 她以對朋友誠實而聞名。

examples.source: He answered the teacher's question truthfully.
examples.target: 他誠實地回答了老師的問題。

examples.source: Truthfully, the project was harder than we expected.
examples.target: 老實說，這個專題比我們預期中困難。

examples.source: She spoke truthfully about her mistake during the meeting.
examples.target: 她在會議上誠實地談及自己的錯誤。

trying.meaning: 難受的 / 令人受考驗的

examples.source: The sudden change at work created a trying time for everyone.
examples.target: 工作上的突然轉變為每個人帶來了一段難受的時期。

examples.source: Looking after a sick child for a whole week was a trying experience.
examples.target: 照顧生病的孩子整整一星期，是一段令人受考驗的經歷。

examples.source: She remained calm despite the trying circumstances of the project.
examples.target: 儘管這個項目處於困難重重的環境下，她依然保持冷靜。

examples.source: The dirty clothes were placed in a plastic tub.
examples.target: 髒衣服被放進塑膠桶裡。

examples.source: I bought a tub of ice cream for the party.
examples.target: 我為派對買了一盒雪糕。

examples.source: The baby splashed water in the tub.
examples.target: 寶寶在浴盆裡拍水。

examples.source: The student struggled to carry his heavy tuba to the music room.
examples.target: 那位學生很吃力地把沉重的大號搬到音樂室。

examples.source: My brother plays the tuba in the school marching band every week.
examples.target: 我哥哥每星期都在學校步操樂隊裡吹奏大號。

examples.source: You can hear the deep sound of the tuba during the concert.
examples.target: 在音樂會期間，你可以聽到大號那低沉的聲音。

examples.source: The student tucked his shirt into his trousers before the school assembly.
examples.target: 那名學生在學校早會前將襯衫塞進褲子裡。

examples.source: She decided to tuck her long hair behind her ears while studying.
examples.target: 她溫習時決定將長頭髮掖到耳後。

examples.source: The blanket was tucked around the sleeping child.
examples.target: 毛毯被掖在熟睡的孩子身邊。

examples.source: She kept her diary tucked away safely in the bottom of her drawer.
examples.target: 她把日記本安全地藏在抽屜的最底層。

examples.source: The student sat with his shirt neatly tucked into his school trousers.
examples.target: 那位學生坐著，校服襯衫整齊地塞進了校褲裡。

examples.source: There is a small, quiet café tucked behind the busy shopping mall.
examples.target: 在繁忙的商場後面，藏著一家寧靜的小咖啡店。

examples.source: We have a mathematics test in school every Tuesday morning.
examples.target: 我們學校每個星期二早上都有數學測驗。

examples.source: I usually go to the public library after school on Tuesdays.
examples.target: 我通常會在星期二放學後去公共圖書館。

examples.source: The basketball team practices in the school hall every Tuesday.
examples.target: 籃球隊每個星期二都會在學校禮堂練習。

examples.source: I felt a sudden tug on my sleeve as we walked to school.
examples.target: 我們走去學校時，我感覺到衣袖被輕輕拉了一下。

examples.source: The rope gave a small tug when the boat moved.
examples.target: 小船移動時，繩子被輕輕拉了一下。

examples.source: She gave her bag a firm tug to check that it was closed.
examples.target: 她用力拉了一下袋子，確認它已經關好。

examples.source: The little boy tugged at his mother's sleeve to get her attention.
examples.target: 小男孩拉了拉媽媽的衣袖，想引起她的注意。

examples.source: She tugged the heavy suitcase across the floor to the school gate.
examples.target: 她把沉重的行李箱拉過地板，一直拉到學校門口。

examples.source: My dog tugged on the leash because he wanted to run outside.
examples.target: 我的狗用力拉著牽繩，因為牠想跑到外面。

examples.source: The powerful tugboat guided the large cargo ship into the harbour safely.
examples.target: 那艘強力的拖船引導大型貨船安全地進入港口。

examples.source: We watched a small tugboat pulling a massive vessel across the calm sea.
examples.target: 我們看著一艘小型拖船在平靜的海面上拖行一艘巨大的船隻。

examples.source: A tugboat helps big ships dock at the container terminal.
examples.target: 拖船協助大型船隻停泊在貨櫃碼頭。

examples.source: She planted a red tulip in the garden this morning.
examples.target: 她今天早上在花園裡種了一朵紅色的鬱金香。

examples.source: The tulip looks beautiful when it blooms in the spring.
examples.target: 鬱金香在春天盛開的時候看起來很漂亮。

examples.source: I bought a bunch of yellow tulips for my mother.
examples.target: 我買了一束黃色的鬱金香送給媽媽。

examples.source: The gymnast performed a perfect tumble across the mat during the competition.
examples.target: 體操運動員在比賽中於墊子上完成了一個完美的翻騰動作。

examples.source: She took a sudden tumble while running down the stairs this morning.
examples.target: 她今天早上跑下樓梯時突然摔了一跤。

examples.source: After a long tumble down the hill, the ball finally stopped moving.
examples.target: 球在山坡上翻滾了很長一段距離後，終於停了下來。

tumble.meaning: 翻滾 / 跌跌撞撞地移動

examples.source: The young boy started to tumble down the grassy hill while playing.
examples.target: 那個小男孩在玩耍時，開始在草坡上翻滾下來。

examples.source: She lost her balance and began to tumble across the slippery floor.
examples.target: 她失去了平衡，開始在濕滑的地板上跌跌撞撞地移動。

examples.source: Empty plastic bottles began to tumble out of the overflowing recycling bin.
examples.target: 空膠樽開始從滿瀉的回收箱中翻滾出來。

examples.source: A tumour is an abnormal growth of cells in the body.
examples.target: 腫瘤是人體內異常生長的細胞組織。

examples.source: The science article explains different types of tumour in simple language.
examples.target: 這篇科學文章用簡單語言解釋不同類型的腫瘤。

examples.source: The textbook describes how doctors study a tumour sample in a laboratory.
examples.target: 課本描述醫生如何在實驗室研究腫瘤樣本。

examples.source: The classroom was in a state of tumult when the teacher announced the surprise holiday.
examples.target: 當老師宣佈突發假期時，課室內一片騷動。

examples.source: She struggled to hear her friend's voice above the tumult of the busy shopping mall.
examples.target: 在繁忙商場的喧囂聲中，她很難聽清楚朋友的聲音。

examples.source: After the initial tumult of the concert, the crowd settled down to enjoy the music.
examples.target: 演唱會初期的騷動過後，觀眾安靜下來享受音樂。

examples.source: The company went through a tumultuous period after the CEO suddenly resigned.
examples.target: 行政總裁突然辭職後，公司經歷了一段動盪的時期。

examples.source: They had a tumultuous relationship, often arguing over minor issues.
examples.target: 他們的關係十分混亂，經常因為小事爭吵。

examples.source: The crowd became tumultuous as the band finally appeared on stage.
examples.target: 樂隊終於登台時，人群變得十分激動混亂。

examples.source: The wind turbine generates electricity for the small village near the coast.
examples.target: 這台風力渦輪機為海岸附近的小村莊提供電力。

examples.source: Engineers checked the turbine to ensure it worked properly.
examples.target: 工程師檢查了渦輪機，以確保它正常運作。

examples.source: A large turbine is used in the power plant to produce energy.
examples.target: 發電廠使用大型渦輪機來產生能源。

turbocharge.meaning: 大幅加速 / 大大增強

examples.source: The new reading plan helped turbocharge the class's progress.
examples.target: 新的閱讀計劃有助大幅加快全班的進度。

examples.source: Investment in new technology can turbocharge local research.
examples.target: 投資新科技可以大大增強本地研究能力。

examples.source: Adding more staff helped turbocharge the team's productivity.
examples.target: 增加人手有助於大幅提升團隊的工作效率。

examples.source: The boat struggled to stay upright in the turbulent waters.
examples.target: 那艘船在湍急的水流中努力保持平衡。

examples.source: The company went through a turbulent period after the manager resigned.
examples.target: 經理辭職後，公司經歷了一段動盪的時期。

examples.source: We experienced some turbulent weather during our flight to Japan.
examples.target: 我們飛往日本的航程中遇到了一些氣流顛簸。

examples.source: The football team practiced hard on the green turf all afternoon today.
examples.target: 足球隊今天整個下午都在綠色的草地上努力練習。

examples.source: We sat on the soft turf to enjoy our lunch in the park.
examples.target: 我們坐在柔軟的草皮上，在公園裡享用午餐。

examples.source: The school replaced the old grass with new artificial turf this summer.
examples.target: 學校在今年夏天把舊草地換成了新的人造草皮。

examples.source: The sudden change in school rules caused turmoil among students.
examples.target: 學校規則突然改變，令學生之間出現一陣混亂。

examples.source: Her mind was in turmoil after hearing the surprising news about the trip.
examples.target: 聽到關於旅行的驚人消息後，她的心情十分混亂。

examples.source: The team was in turmoil before they finally found a new coach.
examples.target: 在找到新教練之前，整支隊伍一直處於混亂狀態。

examples.source: The team made a great turnaround to win the game in the end.
examples.target: 這支隊伍表現大逆轉，最終贏得了比賽。

examples.source: Our school saw a positive turnaround after the new principal joined us.
examples.target: 新校長上任後，我們學校出現了正面的重大轉變。

examples.source: It was a surprising turnaround for him to pass the difficult exam.
examples.target: 他能通過這場艱難的考試，真是一個令人驚訝的轉變。

turquoise.meaning: 綠松石色 / 土耳其石

examples.source: She wore a beautiful turquoise dress to the school summer party yesterday.
examples.target: 她昨天穿了一條漂亮的綠松石色連身裙去參加學校的夏季派對。

examples.source: The clear water in the bay turned a stunning shade of turquoise today.
examples.target: 海灣裡清澈的海水今天變成了迷人的綠松石色。

examples.source: I bought a small ring with a bright turquoise stone for my sister.
examples.target: 我買了一枚鑲有明亮綠松石的小戒指送給我的妹妹。

examples.source: The elephant uses its long tusk to dig for water.
examples.target: 大象用長長的象牙挖掘水源。

examples.source: We saw a walrus with a very large tusk at the aquarium.
examples.target: 我們在水族館看到了一隻長著巨大獠牙的海象。

examples.source: The museum display shows a mammoth with a curved tusk.
examples.target: 博物館展品展示了一隻長著彎曲長牙的長毛象。

examples.source: The two players got into a brief tussle over the ball during the match.
examples.target: 比賽期間，兩名球員為了爭奪球權發生了短暫爭執。

examples.source: There was a small tussle for the last seat on the bus.
examples.target: 大家為巴士上最後一個座位發生了一點爭執。

examples.source: The story describes a political tussle over the new policy.
examples.target: 這個故事描述了圍繞新政策的政治爭鬥。

examples.source: Under the expert tutelage of her piano teacher, she won the competition.
examples.target: 在鋼琴老師的專業指導下，她贏得了比賽。

examples.source: The young athlete flourished under the tutelage of a former Olympic champion.
examples.target: 在那位前奧運冠軍的教導下，這名年輕運動員進步神速。

examples.source: He spent years under the tutelage of his mentor to learn the craft.
examples.target: 他跟隨導師學習多年，在對方的教導下掌握了這門手藝。

examples.source: He plucked the guitar string, and it made a sharp twang.
examples.target: 他撥了一下結他弦，發出嘣的一聲。

examples.source: I heard a sudden twang as the rubber band snapped.
examples.target: 橡皮筋斷掉時，我聽到嘣的一聲。

examples.source: The old wire gave a metallic twang when I touched it.

examples.source: The designer tweaked the settings to make the screen look better.
examples.target: 設計師微調了設定，讓螢幕顯示效果更好。

examples.source: She tweaked the plan slightly to fit the new schedule.
examples.target: 她對計劃做了輕微的微調，以配合新的時間表。

examples.source: I will tweak this paragraph before I submit the essay.
examples.target: 我會在交這篇文章前對這段文字進行微調。

examples.source: He wore a smart tweed jacket to the job interview.
examples.target: 他穿了一件時髦的粗花呢外套去面試。

examples.source: Tweed is a popular choice for autumn and winter clothing.
examples.target: 粗花呢是秋冬服飾的熱門選擇。

examples.source: The fabric of this skirt is made from high-quality tweed.
examples.target: 這條裙子的布料是用優質粗花呢製成的。

tween.meaning: 十至十二歲左右的少年 / 兒童與青少年之間的人

examples.target: 很多十至十二歲的少年放學後喜歡與朋友一起玩電子遊戲。

examples.source: It is common for a tween to start wanting more independence from parents.
examples.target: 十至十二歲的少年開始想要更多獨立空間，是一件很平常的事。

examples.target: 這個故事是為喜歡懸疑和冒險的十至十二歲少年而寫的。

examples.target: 太陽從山丘上升起時，鳥兒開始吱吱喳喳地叫。

examples.source: She decided to tweet about her experience at the concert.

examples.target: 學校學會會在活動期間發推文更新消息。

examples.target: 她發了一則推文，分享她對即將舉行的演唱會的興奮之情。

examples.source: His tweet about the school event was shared by many classmates.
examples.target: 他關於學校活動的推文被許多同學分享。

examples.source: She used a pair of tweezers to pick up the tiny bead.
examples.target: 她用鑷子夾起那顆細小的珠子。

examples.source: The science kit includes tweezers for handling small objects.
examples.target: 科學工具套裝包括用來處理小物件的鑷子。

examples.target: 技術人員用精密鑷子小心處理那些微小零件。

examples.source: The old typewriter still works in the school office.
examples.target: 那部舊打字機在學校辦公室仍然可以運作。

examples.source: My grandfather kept a typewriter on his wooden desk.
examples.target: 我的祖父把一部打字機放在木書桌上。

examples.source: The museum shows a black typewriter from the 1950s.
examples.target: 博物館展示了一部五十年代的黑色打字機。

tackle the issue.meaning: 處理問題 / 解決議題

examples.target: 議會處理廚餘問題。

examples.source: The team tackled the issue in a calm way.
examples.target: 團隊以冷靜方式處理問題。

examples.source: The article tackles the issue of plastic rubbish.
examples.target: 文章探討塑膠垃圾問題。

tackle the problem.meaning: 處理問題 / 解決問題

examples.source: The class tackled the problem together.
examples.target: 全班一起處理問題。

examples.source: Engineers tackled the problem with a new design.
examples.target: 工程師用新設計解決問題。

examples.target: 植物開始纏繞柱子。

examples.target: 她把絲帶纏進頭髮裏。

examples.target: 藤蔓生長時互相纏繞。

examples.source: Typography affects the mood of a website.

examples.source: The novel describes a tyrannical ruler.
examples.target: 小說描寫一位專橫暴虐的統治者。

tailored to.meaning: 為...度身設計的 / 配合...需要的

take a back seat.meaning: 退居幕後 / 不再主導

examples.target: 她讓其他人帶領，自己退居幕後。

take action against.meaning: 採取行動對抗 / 處理

examples.target: 學校採取行動處理欺凌。

examples.target: 我們必須採取行動對抗食物浪費。

examples.target: 公司採取行動處理網上詐騙。

examples.source: We should take all factors into account before deciding.
examples.target: 決定前，我們應把所有因素納入考慮。

examples.target: 報告把所有因素納入考慮。

examples.target: 公平的計劃必須把所有因素納入考慮。

take away from.meaning: 減損 / 分散...的注意力或資源

examples.target: 這個錯誤不會減損你的努力。

examples.target: 太多顏色會分散對主要訊息的注意力。

take away music.meaning: 買走音樂產品 / 把音樂帶回家

examples.target: 粉絲可以在演出後買走音樂產品。

examples.source: The shop lets visitors take away music on CDs.
examples.target: 這間店讓訪客用 CD 把音樂帶回家。

examples.source: Tourists like to take away music as a memory.
examples.target: 遊客喜歡把音樂帶回家作紀念。

examples.source: We can take comfort from small progress.
examples.target: 我們可以從小進步得到安慰。

examples.source: He took comfort from knowing he had tried.
examples.target: 知道自己已經嘗試過，他得到安慰。

examples.source: Good translation takes culture into account.
examples.target: 好的翻譯會把文化因素考慮在內。

examples.target: 學校在課堂中應把文化因素考慮在內。

examples.source: She takes great pride in her work.

examples.target: 團隊對成果非常自豪。

examples.source: Hong Kong people take great pride in local food.
examples.target: 香港人對本地美食非常自豪。

examples.target: 老師考慮到他的努力。

examples.source: We should take cost into consideration.
examples.target: 我們應把成本納入考慮。

take its toll on.meaning: 對...造成損害 / 造成沉重影響

examples.target: 長途旅程對團隊造成沉重影響。

examples.source: Stress can take its toll on sleep.
examples.target: 壓力會對睡眠造成損害。

examples.source: The heat took its toll on the runners.
examples.target: 炎熱天氣對跑手造成沉重影響。

examples.target: 狗追著球跑。

examples.target: 她追趕巴士，但還是錯過了。

take on a new meaning.meaning: 有了新意思 / 帶有新含義

examples.target: 成功對她來說有了新意思。

take on a role.meaning: 擔任角色 / 接受新職務

examples.target: 她接受了組長的新職務。

examples.target: 家長在家中擔任重要角色。

examples.target: 廚師收他為學徒。

examples.target: 一位本地藝術家收她為學徒。

examples.source: The workshop can take on one student as an apprentice.
examples.target: 工房可以收一名學生為學徒。

examples.source: Please take my advice on board.
examples.target: 請聽取我的建議並加以考慮。

examples.source: The team took the feedback on board.
examples.target: 團隊接受並考慮了意見。

examples.source: Good leaders take different views on board.
examples.target: 好的領袖會聽取不同意見。

examples.target: 小型企業可能會在假期聘用員工。

examples.source: The company took on employees after expanding.
examples.target: 公司擴展後聘用了員工。

take on the role of.meaning: 擔任...角色 / 扮演...角色

examples.target: 她擔任班長的角色。

examples.source: He took on the role of a young doctor.
examples.target: 他扮演一位年輕醫生的角色。

examples.source: The teacher took on the role of guide.
examples.target: 老師擔任導遊的角色。

take one's business to.meaning: 轉去光顧 / 把生意轉給

examples.source: Customers may take their business to another shop.
examples.target: 顧客可能會轉去光顧另一間店。

examples.source: If service is poor, people take their business elsewhere.
examples.target: 如果服務差，人們會轉去別處光顧。

examples.source: The family took their business to a local bakery.
examples.target: 這家人轉去光顧本地麵包店。

take one's fancy.meaning: 吸引某人 / 合某人心意

examples.target: 那本藍色筆記簿吸引了我。

examples.target: 選任何合你心意的小食吧。

examples.target: 那間小咖啡店立刻合她心意。

examples.target: 練習可以令你的表現更上一層樓。

examples.target: 學生可以從三個題目中隨意選擇。

examples.target: 書架上的書你可以任意挑選。

take one's toll.meaning: 造成損害 / 帶來壞影響

examples.target: 他們申請按揭買樓。

examples.target: 年輕夫婦可能會為第一個家申請按揭。

examples.target: 學生可以免費辦理會員資格。

examples.target: 他可憐那隻肚餓的狗。

examples.target: 老師同情我們，給了更多時間。

examples.target: 他受傷後，教練讓他停止參賽。

examples.target: 經理讓她停止參與這個 project。

examples.target: 他們把工人撤離危險任務。

examples.target: 音樂使我暫時忘記壓力。

examples.target: 散步可以使你暫時忘記憂慮。

examples.source: The game took his mind off the exam.
examples.target: 遊戲分散了他對考試的注意。

examples.target: 今次我會相信你的話。

examples.source: Do not just take his word for it; check the facts.
examples.target: 不要只相信他的話；要查證事實。

examples.source: She said the restaurant was good, so we took her word for it.
examples.target: 她說餐廳很好，所以我們相信她的話。

examples.source: This tool takes learning to the next level.

examples.target: 她帶頭負責班級 project。

examples.source: The government should take the lead on recycling.
examples.target: 政府應主導回收工作。

take the mystery out of.meaning: 令...不再神秘 / 使...更易明白

examples.target: 老師令文法不再神秘難明。

examples.target: 清晰圖表使過程更易明白。

examples.target: 指南令網絡安全更易明白。

examples.source: The deadline extension took the pressure off.

examples.source: Working together took the pressure off the leader.
examples.target: 一起工作減輕了組長的壓力。

examples.target: 短暫休息可以減輕壓力。

examples.source: The new plan takes things to the next level.
examples.target: 新計劃把事情提升到更高層次。

examples.source: Better teamwork can take things to the next level.
examples.target: 更好的團隊合作可以把事情提升到更高層次。

examples.source: This update takes things to the next level.
examples.target: 這次更新把事情提升到更高層次。

examples.source: The final design takes the app to a whole new level.
examples.target: 最終設計把 app 提升到全新層次。

examples.source: Her confidence took the performance to a whole new level.
examples.target: 她的自信把表演提升到全新層次。

examples.source: The new teacher took the lesson to a whole new level.
examples.target: 新老師把課堂提升到全新層次。

take to the streets.meaning: 走上街頭 / 上街慶祝或示威

examples.target: 粉絲走上街頭慶祝。

examples.source: Citizens took to the streets to express their views.
examples.target: 市民走上街頭表達意見。

examples.source: People took to the streets after the final match.
examples.target: 決賽後，人們上街慶祝。

examples.source: She took up a position at a local school.
examples.target: 她在本地學校就任。

examples.source: He will take up a position as manager.
examples.target: 他將接受經理職位。

examples.source: The new coach took up a position in July.
examples.target: 新教練在七月就任。

examples.source: He took up the habit of reading every night.
examples.target: 他養成每晚閱讀的習慣。

examples.source: Try to take up the habit of planning your day.
examples.target: 嘗試養成計劃每天行程的習慣。

examples.source: She took up the habit of checking new words.
examples.target: 她養成查新字的習慣。

examples.target: 科技會改變工作，不只是搶走人的工作。

examples.target: 他因頂撞老師而惹麻煩。
