examples.target: 她說服弟弟試玩新遊戲。

examples.source: Do not let others talk you into a bad choice.
examples.target: 不要讓別人說服你作出壞選擇。

examples.source: Her parents talked her out of quitting school.
examples.target: 她父母說服她不要退學。

examples.source: I talked him out of buying an expensive phone.
examples.target: 我說服他不要買昂貴手機。

examples.source: The teacher talked the student out of giving up.
examples.target: 老師說服學生不要放棄。

examples.source: It was the most talked-about film of the year.
examples.target: 它是今年最被熱烈討論的電影。

examples.source: The singer became a talked-about star overnight.
examples.target: 那位歌手一夜之間成為被熱烈討論的明星。

examples.source: The new policy was widely talked-about online.
examples.target: 新政策在網上被廣泛討論。

examples.source: The group was tasked with planning the event.
examples.target: 小組被委派負責籌劃活動。

examples.source: She was tasked with checking the report.
examples.target: 她被委派負責檢查報告。

examples.source: The team tasked with safety met every week.
examples.target: 被委派負責安全的團隊每星期開會。

examples.source: The plane taxied for take-off at dawn.
examples.target: 飛機在黎明時滑行準備起飛。

examples.source: Passengers waited while the aircraft taxied for take-off.
examples.target: 飛機滑行準備起飛時，乘客在等待。

examples.source: Our flight began to taxi for take-off after the rain stopped.
examples.target: 雨停後，我們的航班開始滑行準備起飛。

tell on someone.meaning: 告發某人 / 打小報告

examples.source: The boy told on his friend for cheating.
examples.target: 男孩告發朋友作弊。

examples.source: She did not want to tell on her brother.
examples.target: 她不想告發弟弟。

examples.source: Students should report danger, not just tell on someone for fun.
examples.target: 學生應該匯報危險，而不是為好玩而打小報告。

examples.source: Let him tell his side of the story first.
examples.target: 先讓他講述自己一方的說法。

examples.source: She wrote a letter to tell her side of the story.
examples.target: 她寫信講述自己一方的說法。

examples.source: A fair teacher listens to each student tell their side of the story.
examples.target: 公平的老師會聽每個學生講述自己一方的說法。

examples.source: I tense up before speaking on stage.
examples.target: 上台說話前我會緊張起來。

examples.source: Her shoulders tensed up during the exam.
examples.target: 考試期間她的肩膀繃緊了。

examples.source: Try not to tense up when you make a mistake.
examples.target: 犯錯時盡量不要緊張起來。

examples.source: The race helped him test his limits.
examples.target: 比賽幫助他挑戰自己的極限。

examples.source: Learning a new language can test your limits.
examples.target: 學習新語言可以挑戰你的極限。

examples.source: She joined the competition to test her limits.
examples.target: 她參加比賽來挑戰自己的極限。

examples.source: The app uses text-to-speech to read words aloud.
examples.target: 這個 app 用文字轉語音功能讀出單字。

examples.source: Text-to-speech helps students hear pronunciation.
examples.target: 文字轉語音功能幫助學生聽發音。

examples.source: Some phones have built-in text-to-speech.
examples.target: 有些手機有內置文字轉語音功能。

the first time around.meaning: 第一次時 / 初次嘗試時

examples.source: I failed the test the first time around.
examples.target: 我第一次時測驗不合格。

examples.source: The plan did not work the first time around.
examples.target: 計劃初次嘗試時不成功。

examples.source: She understood the rule the first time around.
examples.target: 她第一次時就明白了規則。

examples.source: I thought he taught her, but it was the other way around.
examples.target: 我以為是他教她，但原來相反。

examples.source: The answer is the other way around.
examples.target: 答案是反過來。

examples.source: Children can learn from adults, and the other way around too.
examples.target: 小朋友可以向大人學習，反過來也可以。

the show must go on.meaning: 演出必須繼續 / 無論如何都要繼續

examples.source: The singer was tired, but the show must go on.
examples.target: 歌手很累，但演出必須繼續。

examples.source: When the microphone failed, the show still had to go on.
examples.target: 咪高峰壞了，演出仍然必須繼續。

examples.source: We had problems, but the show must go on.
examples.target: 我們遇到問題，但無論如何都要繼續。

examples.source: The gardener thinned out the small plants.
examples.target: 園丁清走了一部分小植物。

examples.source: The crowd began to thin out after lunch.
examples.target: 午飯後人群開始減少。

examples.source: We need to thin out old files on the computer.
examples.target: 我們需要清走電腦上一部分舊檔案。

examples.source: Students should learn to think for themselves.
examples.target: 學生應學會獨立思考。

examples.source: Do not copy others; think for yourself.
examples.target: 不要抄別人；要獨立思考。

examples.source: Reading different views helps you think for yourself.
examples.target: 閱讀不同觀點有助你獨立思考。

examples.source: Think your answer through before you speak.
examples.target: 說話前先把答案仔細想清楚。

examples.source: She thought the plan through carefully.
examples.target: 她仔細想清楚了這個計劃。

examples.source: We need time to think this problem through.
examples.target: 我們需要時間把這個問題仔細想清楚。

think through.meaning: 仔細想清楚 / 通盤考慮

examples.source: Please think through your choice.
examples.target: 請仔細想清楚你的選擇。

examples.source: The team thought through every step.
examples.target: 團隊通盤考慮了每一步。

examples.source: He acted too quickly and did not think through the risk.
examples.target: 他行動太快，沒有仔細想清楚風險。

examples.source: Can you think up a better title?
examples.target: 你可以想出一個更好的標題嗎？

examples.source: The class thought up a new game.
examples.target: 全班構思出一個新遊戲。

examples.source: She thought up a clever way to remember the word.
examples.target: 她想出一個聰明方法記住這個字。

examples.source: Thread the beads on the string carefully.
examples.target: 小心把珠子串在線上。

examples.source: She threaded flowers on a thin wire.
examples.target: 她把花串在幼鐵線上。

examples.source: The children threaded pasta on string for art class.
examples.target: 孩子們在美術課把意粉串在線上。

examples.source: The customer threatened to sue the company.
examples.target: 顧客威脅要起訴公司。

examples.source: He threatened to sue after the accident.
examples.target: 意外後，他威脅要起訴。

examples.source: The letter threatened to sue unless the problem was fixed.
examples.target: 信中威脅若問題不解決便會起訴。

examples.source: Many animals are threatened with extinction.
examples.target: 很多動物面臨滅絕威脅。

examples.source: The report lists species threatened with extinction.
examples.target: 報告列出面臨滅絕威脅的物種。

examples.source: Plants can also be threatened with extinction.
examples.target: 植物也可能面臨滅絕威脅。

thrilled to bits.meaning: 非常興奮的 / 高興極了

examples.source: She was thrilled to bits with her result.
examples.target: 她對自己的成績高興極了。

examples.source: The children were thrilled to bits at the party.
examples.target: 孩子們在派對上非常興奮。

examples.source: I was thrilled to bits when I won the prize.
examples.target: 我得獎時高興極了。

thrive on.meaning: 靠...而活躍 / 因...而蓬勃

examples.source: Some students thrive on challenges.
examples.target: 有些學生因挑戰而活躍。

examples.source: This plant thrives on sunlight.
examples.target: 這種植物靠陽光而茁壯。

examples.source: The business thrives on good service.
examples.target: 這門生意因良好服務而蓬勃。

through and through.meaning: 徹頭徹尾地 / 完全地

examples.source: He is honest through and through.
examples.target: 他徹頭徹尾地誠實。

examples.source: The team was tired through and through.
examples.target: 團隊完全累透了。

examples.source: She is a Hong Kong girl through and through.
examples.target: 她是個徹頭徹尾的香港女孩。

through birth.meaning: 因出身 / 憑出生背景

examples.source: Some rights were gained through birth.
examples.target: 有些權利是因出身而獲得的。

examples.source: He became a citizen through birth.
examples.target: 他憑出生背景成為公民。

examples.source: Status through birth mattered more in the past.
examples.target: 過去因出身而來的地位更重要。

through the ages.meaning: 歷代以來 / 古往今來

examples.source: Stories have changed through the ages.
examples.target: 故事歷代以來不斷改變。

examples.source: People through the ages have loved music.
examples.target: 古往今來，人們都喜愛音樂。

examples.source: Fashion through the ages tells us about society.
examples.target: 歷代以來的時裝反映社會。

examples.source: The story is told through the eyes of a child.
examples.target: 故事從一個小孩的角度講述。

examples.source: We saw the city through the eyes of a tourist.
examples.target: 我們從遊客的角度看這個城市。

examples.source: The film shows school life through the eyes of students.
examples.target: 電影從學生的角度展示校園生活。

through the roof.meaning: 大幅上升的 / 極高的

examples.source: House prices are through the roof.
examples.target: 樓價極高。

examples.source: Demand for the toy went through the roof.
examples.target: 這款玩具的需求大幅上升。

examples.source: Her confidence was through the roof after the win.
examples.target: 勝利後她的自信極高。

through thick and thin.meaning: 同甘共苦 / 無論順境逆境

examples.source: True friends stay together through thick and thin.
examples.target: 真正朋友會同甘共苦。

examples.source: Her family supported her through thick and thin.
examples.target: 她的家人無論順境逆境都支持她。

examples.source: The team worked through thick and thin.
examples.target: 團隊同甘共苦地工作。

throw in.meaning: 順便加入 / 額外加入

examples.source: The shop threw in a free bag.
examples.target: 店舖額外送了一個免費袋。

examples.source: Can you throw in one more example?
examples.target: 你可以順便加入多一個例子嗎？

examples.source: The teacher threw in a quick revision game.
examples.target: 老師順便加入了一個快速溫習遊戲。

examples.source: She tried to throw off her nervousness.
examples.target: 她嘗試擺脫緊張。

examples.source: The runner threw off the other competitors.
examples.target: 跑手甩開了其他參賽者。

examples.source: A good rest helped him throw off the cold.
examples.target: 好好休息幫他擺脫感冒。

examples.source: The guard threw out the troublemaker.
examples.target: 保安趕走了搞事的人。

examples.source: They were thrown out of the meeting for shouting.
examples.target: 他們因大叫而被逐出會議。

examples.source: The referee threw out the player after the fight.
examples.target: 打架後，裁判逐出了那名球員。

throw-away mentality.meaning: 即棄心態 / 用完即棄心態

examples.source: A throw-away mentality creates more waste.
examples.target: 即棄心態製造更多垃圾。

examples.source: We should move away from a throw-away mentality.
examples.target: 我們應遠離用完即棄心態。

examples.source: Repairing items can fight the throw-away mentality.
examples.target: 修理物品可以對抗即棄心態。

throw-away society.meaning: 即棄型社會 / 浪費型社會

examples.source: A throw-away society wastes too many resources.
examples.target: 即棄型社會浪費太多資源。

examples.source: The article criticises our throw-away society.
examples.target: 文章批評我們的浪費型社會。

examples.source: Recycling alone cannot fix a throw-away society.
examples.target: 單靠回收不能解決即棄型社會的問題。

examples.source: The lesson ties in with our exam topic.
examples.target: 這堂課與我們的考試題目有關連。

examples.source: The activity ties in with the reading passage.
examples.target: 活動與閱讀篇章配合。

examples.source: Her idea ties in with the school's plan.
examples.target: 她的想法與學校計劃配合。

examples.source: Good examples are tied to reality.
examples.target: 好的例子與現實緊密相連。

examples.source: The story is imaginative but still tied to reality.
examples.target: 故事很有想像力，但仍與現實緊密相連。

examples.source: Lessons feel useful when they are tied to reality.
examples.target: 課堂與現實緊密相連時會感覺有用。

examples.source: Keep noise to a minimum in the library.
examples.target: 在圖書館要把噪音減至最低。

examples.source: We should keep waste to a minimum.
examples.target: 我們應把浪費減至最低。

examples.source: The app keeps waiting time to a minimum.
examples.target: 這個 app 把等待時間減至最低。

to be blunt.meaning: 坦白說 / 直截了當地說

examples.source: To be blunt, the answer is wrong.
examples.target: 坦白說，答案是錯的。

examples.source: To be blunt, we need more practice.
examples.target: 直截了當地說，我們需要更多練習。

examples.source: To be blunt, the plan is not ready.
examples.target: 坦白說，計劃還未準備好。

examples.source: To be frank, I do not understand the question.
examples.target: 坦白說，我不明白這條問題。

examples.source: To be frank, the work was harder than expected.
examples.target: 坦白說，工作比預期更難。

examples.source: To be frank, she gave the best answer.
examples.target: 坦白說，她給了最好的答案。

examples.source: This is his best result to date.
examples.target: 這是他至今最好的成績。

examples.source: To date, we have learned fifty words.
examples.target: 到目前為止，我們已學了五十個字。

examples.source: No one has solved the problem to date.
examples.target: 至今仍未有人解決這個問題。

examples.source: Eating to excess can harm your health.
examples.target: 過度進食會傷害健康。

examples.source: He worries to excess before every exam.
examples.target: 每次考試前他都過度擔心。

examples.source: Do not use your phone to excess.
examples.target: 不要過度使用手機。

examples.source: To make a long story short, we missed the train.
examples.target: 長話短說，我們錯過了火車。

examples.source: To make a long story short, the plan worked.
examples.target: 長話短說，計劃成功了。

examples.source: To make a long story short, she changed schools.
examples.target: 長話短說，她轉校了。

to my dismay.meaning: 令我失望的是 / 令我沮喪的是

examples.source: To my dismay, I lost my homework.
examples.target: 令我沮喪的是，我遺失了功課。

examples.source: To my dismay, the shop was closed.
examples.target: 令我失望的是，店舖關門了。

examples.source: To my dismay, the answer was still wrong.
examples.target: 令我沮喪的是，答案仍然錯。

examples.source: Use your experience to your advantage.
examples.target: 善用你的經驗，令它對你有利。

examples.source: Knowing two languages worked to her advantage.
examples.target: 懂兩種語言對她有利。

examples.source: He turned the mistake to his advantage.
examples.target: 他把錯誤轉化成對自己有利。

examples.source: The issue was solved to her satisfaction.
examples.target: 問題解決到令她滿意的程度。

examples.source: He completed the work to the teacher's satisfaction.
examples.target: 他完成工作，達到老師滿意的程度。

examples.source: The meal was cooked to my satisfaction.
examples.target: 這餐飯煮得令我滿意。

to one's taste.meaning: 合某人口味 / 合某人喜好

examples.source: The soup was too salty to my taste.
examples.target: 這湯對我口味來說太鹹。

examples.source: The design is simple and to her taste.
examples.target: 設計簡單，合她喜好。

examples.source: Choose a book that is to your taste.
examples.target: 選一本合你喜好的書。

to say the least.meaning: 至少可以說 / 說得保守一點

examples.source: The result was disappointing, to say the least.
examples.target: 說得保守一點，結果令人失望。

examples.source: The journey was tiring, to say the least.
examples.target: 至少可以說，旅程很累人。

examples.source: His answer was strange, to say the least.
examples.target: 說得保守一點，他的答案很奇怪。

examples.source: To some degree, I agree with you.
examples.target: 在某程度上，我同意你。

examples.source: Stress affects everyone to some degree.
examples.target: 壓力在某程度上影響每個人。

examples.source: The plan worked to some degree.
examples.target: 計劃在某程度上有效。

examples.source: He improved to the extent that he could teach others.
examples.target: 他進步到可以教別人的程度。

examples.source: She was tired to the extent that she fell asleep at once.
examples.target: 她累到立刻睡著的程度。

examples.source: The noise grew to the extent that we could not talk.
examples.target: 噪音大到我們不能交談的程度。

examples.source: He helped to the extent of paying for the books.
examples.target: 他幫忙到支付書本費的程度。

examples.source: The room was damaged to the extent of needing repairs.
examples.target: 房間損壞到需要維修的程度。

examples.source: She trusted him to the extent of sharing her plan.
examples.target: 她信任他到分享自己計劃的程度。

to top it all off.meaning: 更糟的是 / 最後還有

examples.source: It rained, and to top it all off, I lost my keys.
examples.target: 下雨了，更糟的是，我遺失了鎖匙。

examples.source: The bus was late, and to top it all off, it was full.
examples.target: 巴士遲到，最後還有，車上爆滿。

examples.source: He forgot his notes, and to top it all off, his pen broke.
examples.target: 他忘記帶筆記，更糟的是，筆也壞了。

examples.source: Please tone down your message before sending it.
examples.target: 傳送前請把訊息語氣緩和一點。

examples.source: The designer toned down the bright colours.
examples.target: 設計師降低了鮮色的強度。

examples.source: He toned down his criticism in the meeting.
examples.target: 他在會議中緩和了批評語氣。

examples.source: The offer sounded too good to be true.
examples.target: 這個優惠聽起來好得令人難以置信。

examples.source: If a prize is too good to be true, check carefully.
examples.target: 如果獎品好得令人難以置信，要小心查清楚。

examples.source: The story was almost too good to be true.
examples.target: 這個故事幾乎好得令人難以置信。

examples.source: The team tossed out the first idea.
examples.target: 團隊否決了第一個想法。

examples.source: Do not toss out useful notes.
examples.target: 不要捨棄有用的筆記。

examples.source: The judge tossed out the weak claim.
examples.target: 法官否決了薄弱的申索。

examples.source: The small boat was tossed around by the waves.
examples.target: 小船被海浪拋來拋去。

examples.source: Ideas were tossed around during the meeting.
examples.target: 會議期間很多想法被拋出討論。

examples.source: The ball was tossed around the playground.
examples.target: 球在操場上被拋來拋去。

examples.source: The plane touched down safely.
examples.target: 飛機安全著陸。

examples.source: We touched down in Tokyo at night.
examples.target: 我們晚上在東京降落。

examples.source: The flight will touch down in ten minutes.
examples.target: 航班將於十分鐘後著陸。

examples.source: The article touches on climate change.
examples.target: 文章簡略談及氣候變化。

examples.source: The teacher touched on the topic briefly.
examples.target: 老師簡略提到這個題目。

examples.source: Her speech touched on family life.
examples.target: 她的演說提到家庭生活。

touch on a subject.meaning: 觸及一個題材 / 談及一個主題

examples.source: The book touches on a subject that many students know.
examples.target: 這本書觸及一個很多學生都認識的題材。

examples.source: The film touches on a subject about friendship.
examples.target: 電影談及一個關於友情的主題。

examples.source: The lesson touched on a difficult subject gently.
examples.target: 課堂溫和地觸及一個困難題材。

touch on issues.meaning: 觸及議題 / 談及問題

examples.source: The article touches on issues of food waste.
examples.target: 文章觸及食物浪費的議題。

examples.source: The debate touched on issues facing teenagers.
examples.target: 辯論談及青少年面對的問題。

examples.source: Her report touches on issues in online learning.
examples.target: 她的報告觸及網上學習的問題。

examples.source: She touched up the photo before posting it.
examples.target: 她發佈相片前先修圖。

examples.source: The artist touched up the painting.
examples.target: 藝術家潤飾了畫作。

examples.source: He touched up the poster colours.
examples.target: 他潤飾了海報顏色。

examples.source: The photo needs a small touch-up.
examples.target: 這張相需要少量修圖。

examples.source: A quick touch-up made the poster clearer.
examples.target: 快速潤飾令海報更清楚。

examples.source: The wall only needs a touch-up.
examples.target: 牆壁只需要潤飾一下。

examples.source: The final result was tough to swallow.
examples.target: 最後結果難以接受。

examples.source: His criticism was tough to swallow but useful.
examples.target: 他的批評難以接受，但有用。

examples.source: Losing by one point was tough to swallow.
examples.target: 輸一分令人難以接受。

examples.source: Challenges can help students toughen up.
examples.target: 挑戰可以幫助學生變堅強。

examples.source: He toughened up after the difficult training.
examples.target: 艱苦訓練後，他變得堅強。

examples.source: You do not need to be rude to toughen up.
examples.target: 要變堅強，不需要變得無禮。

examples.source: The boat was towed back to shore safely.
examples.target: 小船被安全拖回岸邊。

examples.source: Rescuers towed the broken canoe back to shore.
examples.target: 救援人員把壞了的獨木舟拖回岸邊。

examples.source: The fishing boat had to be towed back to shore.
examples.target: 漁船要被拖回岸邊。

examples.source: The tradition traces back hundreds of years.
examples.target: 這個傳統可追溯至數百年前。

examples.source: We traced the mistake back to one missing number.
examples.target: 我們把錯誤追溯至一個遺漏的數字。

examples.source: The word can trace back to Latin.
examples.target: 這個字可追溯至拉丁文。

trade in.meaning: 以舊換新 / 折價換購

examples.source: You can trade in your old phone.
examples.target: 你可以用舊手機以舊換新。

examples.source: He traded in his bike for a newer one.
examples.target: 他用舊單車折價換購新單車。

examples.source: The shop lets customers trade in old tablets.
examples.target: 店舖讓顧客用舊平板電腦折價換購。

examples.source: The school transitioned to online lessons.
examples.target: 學校過渡到網上課堂。

examples.source: Many shops transitioned to digital payment.
examples.target: 很多店舖轉入電子支付。

examples.source: Students need time to transition to secondary school.
examples.target: 學生需要時間過渡到中學。

examples.source: Small changes can translate to big savings.
examples.target: 小改變可以帶來大節省。

examples.source: Better sleep often translates to better focus.
examples.target: 更好睡眠通常會帶來更好專注力。

examples.source: More practice does not always translate to higher marks.
examples.target: 更多練習不一定轉化為更高分數。

treat oneself to.meaning: 用...獎勵自己 / 享受一下

examples.source: I treated myself to a cake after the exam.
examples.target: 考試後我用一件蛋糕獎勵自己。

examples.source: She treated herself to a quiet afternoon.
examples.target: 她讓自己享受一個安靜的下午。

examples.source: After saving money, he treated himself to a new book.
examples.target: 儲錢後，他用一本新書獎勵自己。

treat someone to.meaning: 請某人享用 / 招待某人

examples.source: My uncle treated us to dinner.
examples.target: 叔叔請我們吃晚飯。

examples.source: She treated her friend to ice cream.
examples.target: 她請朋友吃雪糕。

examples.source: The school treated students to a special show.
examples.target: 學校招待學生欣賞特別表演。

examples.source: The gardener trimmed off the dead leaves.
examples.target: 園丁修剪掉枯葉。

examples.source: Trim off the extra paper around the picture.
examples.target: 把圖片旁邊多出的紙剪掉。

examples.source: We trimmed off a few unnecessary words.
examples.target: 我們減去了幾個不必要的字。

examples.source: The old village was a trip back in time.
examples.target: 這條古村像一次時光倒流般的體驗。

examples.source: Visiting the museum felt like a trip back in time.
examples.target: 參觀博物館感覺像時光倒流。

examples.source: The black-and-white photos gave us a trip back in time.
examples.target: 黑白照片給我們時光倒流般的體驗。

examples.source: In the story, kindness triumphs over evil.
examples.target: 在故事中，善良戰勝邪惡。

examples.source: The film shows heroes triumphing over evil.
examples.target: 電影展示英雄戰勝邪惡。

examples.source: Many fairy tales end with good triumphing over evil.
examples.target: 很多童話都以善良戰勝邪惡作結。

examples.source: I tried my hand at baking bread.
examples.target: 我嘗試做麵包。

examples.source: She tried her hand at writing a poem.
examples.target: 她嘗試寫一首詩。

examples.source: Students tried their hand at coding in class.
examples.target: 學生在課堂上嘗試寫程式。

tuck into.meaning: 大口吃 / 津津有味地吃

examples.source: The children tucked into the hot noodles.
examples.target: 孩子們津津有味地吃熱湯麵。

examples.source: We tucked into dinner after the long trip.
examples.target: 長途旅程後，我們大口吃晚飯。

examples.source: He tucked into a bowl of rice.
examples.target: 他津津有味地吃一碗飯。

tucked away.meaning: 藏在角落的 / 不顯眼的

examples.source: The cafe is tucked away in a quiet street.
examples.target: 咖啡店藏在一條安靜街道。

examples.source: We found a tucked-away bookstore.
examples.target: 我們找到一間不顯眼的書店。

examples.source: The small temple was tucked away behind tall buildings.
examples.target: 小廟藏在高樓後面。

tucked into.meaning: 藏在...裏的 / 位於...深處的

examples.source: The village is tucked into the hills.
examples.target: 村莊位於山丘深處。

examples.source: A note was tucked into the book.
examples.target: 一張紙條藏在書裏。

examples.source: The shop is tucked into a narrow lane.
examples.target: 店舖藏在一條窄巷裏。

examples.source: The ball tumbled down the stairs.
examples.target: 球從樓梯翻滾落下。

examples.source: Her hair tumbled down over her shoulders.
examples.target: 她的頭髮垂落在肩上。

examples.source: Leaves tumbled down from the tree.
examples.target: 樹葉從樹上飄落下來。

tune out.meaning: 不理會 / 忽略周圍事物

examples.source: He tuned out during the long speech.
examples.target: 漫長演說期間，他開始不理會。

examples.source: Do not tune out when others are speaking.
examples.target: 別人說話時不要不理會。

examples.source: Music helps her tune out the noise.
examples.target: 音樂幫助她忽略噪音。

examples.source: The ants tunneled into the soil.
examples.target: 螞蟻挖隧道進入泥土。

examples.source: Workers tunneled into the mountain carefully.
examples.target: 工人小心地挖隧道進入山裏。

examples.source: The rabbit tunneled into the soft ground.
examples.target: 兔子挖洞進入鬆軟地面。

examples.source: Her results turned around after regular practice.
examples.target: 定期練習後，她的成績好轉。

examples.source: The new coach turned the team around.
examples.target: 新教練令團隊徹底改善。

examples.source: A clear plan can turn a project around.
examples.target: 清晰計劃可以令 project 好轉。

turn away.meaning: 拒絕進入 / 轉身離開

examples.source: The guard turned away visitors without tickets.
examples.target: 保安拒絕沒有門票的訪客進入。

examples.source: She turned away when she felt upset.
examples.target: 她感到難過時轉身離開。

examples.source: The full restaurant had to turn away customers.
examples.target: 爆滿的餐廳不得不拒絕顧客進入。

turn away.meaning: 拒絕接受 / 不准進入

examples.source: The school did not turn away students who needed help.
examples.target: 學校沒有拒絕接受需要幫助的學生。

examples.source: The centre may turn away late applications.
examples.target: 中心可能拒絕接受逾期申請。

examples.source: No patient should be turned away in an emergency.
examples.target: 緊急情況下不應拒絕接受任何病人。

turn away from.meaning: 使遠離 / 令...失去興趣

examples.source: Bad service can turn customers away from a shop.
examples.target: 差劣服務會令顧客遠離一間店。

examples.source: Do not let one mistake turn you away from learning.
examples.target: 不要讓一次錯誤令你對學習失去興趣。

examples.source: The boring design turned users away from the app.
examples.target: 沉悶設計令用戶對 app 失去興趣。

turn into a career.meaning: 變成職業 / 發展成事業

examples.source: Her hobby turned into a career.
examples.target: 她的興趣變成職業。

examples.source: He hopes music will turn into a career.
examples.target: 他希望音樂能發展成事業。

examples.source: A small online shop can turn into a career.
examples.target: 一間小網店可以變成職業。

examples.source: He turned his back and walked away.
examples.target: 他背過身然後走開。

examples.source: Do not turn your back on people who need help.
examples.target: 不要對需要幫助的人轉身不理。

examples.source: She turned her back to hide her tears.
examples.target: 她背過身隱藏眼淚。

examples.source: The thief turned himself in the next day.
examples.target: 小偷第二天自首。

examples.source: She decided to turn herself in after telling the truth.
examples.target: 說出真相後，她決定自首。

examples.source: The police asked the suspect to turn himself in.
examples.target: 警方要求疑犯自首。

examples.source: Education can turn our lives around.
examples.target: 教育可以扭轉我們的人生。

examples.source: One good chance may turn our lives around.
examples.target: 一個好機會可能扭轉我們的人生。

examples.source: Hard work helped turn our lives around.
examples.target: 努力幫助扭轉我們的人生。

examples.source: Please turn the documents over to the office.
examples.target: 請把文件交給辦公室。

examples.source: The case was turned over to the police.
examples.target: 案件已移交給警方。

examples.source: He turned the project over to a new team.
examples.target: 他把 project 移交給新團隊。

examples.source: A new plan helped turn things around.
examples.target: 新計劃幫助扭轉局面。

examples.source: The team turned things around in the second half.
examples.target: 團隊在下半場扭轉局面。

examples.source: It is not too late to turn things around.
examples.target: 現在扭轉局面還未太遲。

examples.source: I turned to my teacher for advice.
examples.target: 我向老師尋求意見。

examples.source: She turns to her parents for advice when she is unsure.
examples.target: 她不確定時會向父母尋求意見。

examples.source: Students can turn to older classmates for advice.
examples.target: 學生可以向高年級同學尋求意見。

examples.source: The story has a clever twist in the tale.
examples.target: 故事結尾有聰明的意外轉折。

examples.source: Readers loved the twist in the tale.
examples.target: 讀者喜歡故事結尾的意外轉折。

examples.source: A twist in the tale made the ending memorable.
examples.target: 故事結尾的意外轉折令結局難忘。

tackle head-on.meaning: 正面處理 / 迎面解決

examples.source: The school tackled the problem head-on.
examples.target: 學校正面處理問題。

examples.source: Good leaders tackle challenges head-on.
examples.target: 好領袖會迎面解決挑戰。

examples.source: She decided to tackle her fear head-on.
examples.target: 她決定正面處理自己的恐懼。

take a big chunk out of.meaning: 大幅削減 / 佔去一大部分

examples.source: Rent takes a big chunk out of his salary.
examples.target: 租金佔去他薪金一大部分。

examples.source: The new fee took a big chunk out of the budget.
examples.target: 新收費大幅削減了預算。

examples.source: Homework can take a big chunk out of students' free time.
examples.target: 功課會佔去學生空閒時間一大部分。

take a deep dive into.meaning: 深入鑽研 / 深入探索

examples.source: The class took a deep dive into the poem.
examples.target: 全班深入鑽研那首詩。

examples.source: The report takes a deep dive into teen habits.
examples.target: 報告深入探索青少年習慣。

examples.source: We took a deep dive into grammar patterns.
examples.target: 我們深入鑽研文法句式。

take a heavy toll on.meaning: 對...造成嚴重損害 / 沉重打擊

examples.source: Lack of sleep takes a heavy toll on health.
examples.target: 缺乏睡眠對健康造成嚴重損害。

examples.source: The storm took a heavy toll on the village.
examples.target: 暴風對村莊造成沉重打擊。

examples.source: Exam stress can take a heavy toll on students.
examples.target: 考試壓力會對學生造成嚴重損害。

take an issue up with.meaning: 向...提出問題 / 與...跟進問題

examples.source: Please take the issue up with the office.
examples.target: 請向辦公室提出這個問題。

examples.source: She took the issue up with her teacher.
examples.target: 她與老師跟進這個問題。

examples.source: Parents can take an issue up with the school politely.
examples.target: 家長可以禮貌地向學校提出問題。

examples.source: I take issue with that unfair comment.
examples.target: 我對那句不公平評論有異議。

examples.source: The writer takes issue with the new policy.
examples.target: 作者不同意新政策。

examples.source: Students may take issue with unclear rules.
examples.target: 學生可能對不清晰規則有異議。

examples.source: Do not take your stress out on your classmates.
examples.target: 不要向同學發洩壓力。

examples.source: He was angry, but he should not take it out on his brother.
examples.target: 他很生氣，但不應拿弟弟出氣。

examples.source: Tired people sometimes take it out on others.
examples.target: 疲倦的人有時會向別人發洩。

examples.source: The class did not take kindly to extra homework.
examples.target: 全班不樂意接受額外功課。

examples.source: She takes kindly to honest feedback.
examples.target: 她樂意接受誠實回饋。

examples.source: Cats may not take kindly to loud noises.
examples.target: 貓可能不喜歡大聲噪音。

take on a life of its own.meaning: 自行發展起來 / 變得有生命力

examples.source: The joke took on a life of its own online.
examples.target: 笑話在網上自行發展起來。

examples.source: The project soon took on a life of its own.
examples.target: 項目很快變得有生命力。

examples.source: A small idea can take on a life of its own.
examples.target: 一個小想法可以自行發展起來。

examples.source: The designer takes her cues from nature.
examples.target: 設計師借鑑大自然。

examples.source: Students can take their cues from strong model answers.
examples.target: 學生可以以優秀範文為參考。

examples.source: The film takes its cues from old detective stories.
examples.target: 電影借鑑舊偵探故事。

take one's sweet time.meaning: 慢慢來 / 花很長時間

examples.source: He took his sweet time finishing the form.
examples.target: 他慢慢來，花很長時間填表。

examples.source: The bus took its sweet time arriving.
examples.target: 巴士花了很長時間才到。

examples.source: Do not take your sweet time when others are waiting.
examples.target: 別人在等時，不要慢慢來。

take over the reins.meaning: 接掌控制權 / 接手負責

examples.source: The new captain took over the reins.
examples.target: 新隊長接掌控制權。

examples.source: She took over the reins after the manager left.
examples.target: 經理離開後，她接手負責。

examples.source: The founder's daughter will take over the reins next year.
examples.target: 創辦人的女兒明年會接掌控制權。

take someone up on an offer.meaning: 接受某人的提議 / 答應某人的邀請

examples.source: I took her up on her offer to help.
examples.target: 我接受了她幫忙的提議。

examples.source: He took the teacher up on the offer of extra practice.
examples.target: 他接受老師額外練習的提議。

examples.source: They took us up on our dinner invitation.
examples.target: 他們答應了我們的晚餐邀請。

take someone up on an offer.meaning: 接受某人的提議 / 接受邀請

examples.source: She took him up on his offer of a lift.
examples.target: 她接受了他載她一程的提議。

examples.source: The class took the museum up on its offer of free tickets.
examples.target: 全班接受了博物館免費門票的提議。

examples.source: If you need help, take me up on my offer.
examples.target: 如果你需要幫忙，就接受我的提議吧。

examples.source: I would take the expert's word over a rumour.
examples.target: 我會相信專家的話多於謠言。

examples.source: Do not take one stranger's word over clear evidence.
examples.target: 不要相信陌生人的話多於清楚證據。

examples.source: She took her coach's word over online advice.
examples.target: 她相信教練的話多於網上建議。

take something in one's stride.meaning: 從容應付 / 處之泰然

examples.source: She took the bad news in her stride.
examples.target: 她從容應付壞消息。

examples.source: Good leaders take pressure in their stride.
examples.target: 好領袖會對壓力處之泰然。

examples.source: He took the sudden change in his stride.
examples.target: 他從容應付突如其來的改變。

take the lid off.meaning: 打開限制 / 釋放出來

examples.source: The new rule took the lid off creative teaching.
examples.target: 新規則打開了創意教學的限制。

examples.source: The article took the lid off public anger.
examples.target: 文章釋放出公眾怒氣。

examples.source: Better tools can take the lid off student potential.
examples.target: 更好的工具可以釋放學生潛能。

examples.source: The family decided to take the matter to court.
examples.target: 那家人決定將事件告上法庭。

examples.source: If the company refuses to help, we may take the matter to court.
examples.target: 如果公司拒絕幫忙，我們可能會將事件告上法庭。

examples.source: The report says some customers took the matter to court.
examples.target: 報道指有些顧客將事件告上法庭。

take to heart.meaning: 銘記在心 / 認真看待

examples.source: She took the teacher's advice to heart.
examples.target: 她把老師的建議銘記在心。

examples.source: Do not take every rude comment to heart.
examples.target: 不要把每句無禮評論都太認真看待。

examples.source: He took the warning to heart and worked more carefully.
examples.target: 他把警告銘記在心，做事更小心。

take to something like a duck to water.meaning: 很快適應某事 / 如魚得水

examples.source: She took to debating like a duck to water.
examples.target: 她很快適應辯論，表現得如魚得水。

examples.source: The new student took to the school like a duck to water.
examples.target: 新同學很快適應學校生活。

examples.source: He took to using the new app like a duck to water.
examples.target: 他很快適應使用新的應用程式。

take to something like a fish to water.meaning: 很快適應 / 如魚得水

examples.source: He took to public speaking like a fish to water.
examples.target: 他很快適應公開演講，表現得如魚得水。

examples.source: My sister took to her new job like a fish to water.
examples.target: 我姐姐很快適應新工作。

examples.source: The class took to the project like a fish to water.
examples.target: 全班很快適應這個專題研習。

examples.source: The writer took up residence in a small village.
examples.target: 那位作家在一條小村莊定居。

examples.source: Several artists took up residence in the old factory.
examples.target: 幾位藝術家進駐了舊工廠。

examples.source: After retirement, they took up residence near the sea.
examples.target: 退休後，他們在海邊定居。

examples.source: The young coach took up the reins of the team.
examples.target: 年輕教練接手管理球隊。

examples.source: She took up the reins after the director resigned.
examples.target: 總監辭職後，她接掌主導。

examples.source: It is time for a new leader to take up the reins.
examples.target: 是時候由新領袖接手了。

take with a grain of salt.meaning: 半信半疑 / 不要盡信

examples.source: Take online rumours with a grain of salt.
examples.target: 對網上謠言要半信半疑，不要盡信。

examples.source: We should take the advertisement with a grain of salt.
examples.target: 我們應該對廣告內容有所保留。

examples.source: I take his story with a grain of salt until I see proof.
examples.target: 在看到證據前，我對他的說法半信半疑。

take with a grain of salt.meaning: 對...半信半疑 / 不要完全相信

examples.source: Take this prediction with a grain of salt.
examples.target: 對這個預測不要完全相信。

examples.source: The article is interesting, but take it with a grain of salt.
examples.target: 這篇文章有趣，但不要完全相信。

examples.source: Students should take anonymous comments with a grain of salt.
examples.target: 學生應該對匿名評論半信半疑。

take your life in your hands.meaning: 冒生命危險 / 把生命置於危險中

examples.source: You take your life in your hands if you drive in a storm.
examples.target: 如果在暴風雨中駕駛，你是在冒生命危險。

examples.source: Climbing without safety equipment is taking your life in your hands.
examples.target: 沒有安全裝備攀爬就是把生命置於危險中。

examples.source: The guide warned us not to take our lives in our hands.
examples.target: 導遊警告我們不要冒生命危險。

take-back programme.meaning: 回收計劃 / 舊物回收計劃

examples.source: The shop runs a take-back programme for old phones.
examples.target: 這間店為舊手機設有回收計劃。

examples.source: A take-back programme can reduce electronic waste.
examples.target: 舊物回收計劃可以減少電子廢物。

examples.source: Students joined a take-back programme for used uniforms.
examples.target: 學生參加了舊校服回收計劃。

tap into a trend.meaning: 把握潮流 / 乘上趨勢

examples.source: The brand tapped into a trend for healthy snacks.
examples.target: 該品牌把握健康小食的潮流。

examples.source: Many cafés tap into a trend by selling matcha drinks.
examples.target: 許多咖啡店售賣抹茶飲品來乘上趨勢。

examples.source: The app tapped into a trend among young learners.
examples.target: 這個應用程式把握了年輕學習者的潮流。

tears prick one's eyes.meaning: 眼泛淚光 / 眼睛刺痛想哭

examples.source: Tears pricked her eyes when she heard the song.
examples.target: 她聽到那首歌時眼泛淚光。

examples.source: Tears pricked my eyes as I read the letter.
examples.target: 我讀那封信時眼睛刺痛想哭。

examples.source: Tears pricked his eyes, but he kept smiling.
examples.target: 他眼泛淚光，但仍然保持微笑。

tease out.meaning: 小心拔出 / 慢慢弄出

examples.source: The doctor teased out a tiny piece of glass.
examples.target: 醫生小心拔出一小塊玻璃。

examples.source: The teacher helped us tease out the main idea.
examples.target: 老師幫我們慢慢弄清主要意思。

examples.source: Good questions can tease out hidden details.
examples.target: 好的問題可以慢慢引出隱藏細節。

teeming with.meaning: 充滿...的 / 到處都是...的

examples.source: The market was teeming with shoppers.
examples.target: 市場到處都是購物的人。

examples.source: The pond is teeming with small fish.
examples.target: 池塘裏充滿小魚。

examples.source: The article is teeming with useful examples.
examples.target: 這篇文章充滿有用例子。

temple to consumerism.meaning: 消費主義聖殿 / 消費主義象徵

examples.source: Some critics call the mall a temple to consumerism.
examples.target: 有些評論者稱這個商場為消費主義聖殿。

examples.source: The huge shopping centre became a temple to consumerism.
examples.target: 這座大型購物中心成為消費主義象徵。

examples.source: The essay describes the city as a temple to consumerism.
examples.target: 文章把這座城市形容為消費主義象徵。

examples.source: Her success is a testament to her hard work.
examples.target: 她的成功證明了她的努力。

examples.source: The old bridge is a testament to careful design.
examples.target: 這座舊橋證明了細心設計的重要。

examples.source: The full classroom is a testament to his popularity.
examples.target: 坐滿人的課室證明了他很受歡迎。

examples.source: Many teenagers feel tethered to their phones.
examples.target: 許多青少年覺得自己離不開手機。

examples.source: The plan is tethered to a tight budget.
examples.target: 這個計劃受緊張預算束縛。

examples.source: He felt tethered to old habits.
examples.target: 他覺得自己被舊習慣束縛。

examples.source: The village felt like the back of beyond.
examples.target: 那條村感覺像偏遠荒僻的地方。

examples.source: My uncle lives in the back of beyond.
examples.target: 我叔叔住在非常偏遠的地方。

examples.source: The hotel was in the back of beyond, far from any station.
examples.target: 酒店位於偏遠荒僻的地方，離任何車站都很遠。

the ball is in someone's court.meaning: 輪到某人採取行動 / 責任在某人身上

examples.source: I sent the email, so the ball is in his court now.
examples.target: 我已寄出電郵，所以現在輪到他採取行動。

examples.source: After our offer, the ball is in the school's court.
examples.target: 我們提出建議後，責任就在學校一方。

examples.source: The ball is in your court; please decide by Friday.
examples.target: 現在輪到你決定，請在星期五前回覆。

the jury is out.meaning: 尚未有定論 / 未能下結論

examples.source: The jury is out on whether the policy will work.
examples.target: 這項政策是否有效尚未有定論。

examples.source: The jury is still out after the first trial lesson.
examples.target: 第一次試堂後仍未能下結論。

examples.source: The jury is out on the new teaching method.
examples.target: 新的教學方法是否有效仍未有定論。

examples.source: The jury is still out on the new timetable.
examples.target: 新時間表是否合適尚未有定論。

examples.source: The jury is still out, so we need more evidence.
examples.target: 事情尚未有定論，所以我們需要更多證據。

examples.source: The jury is still out on the long-term result.
examples.target: 長遠結果尚未有定論。

examples.source: The proof is in the pudding; try the app first.
examples.target: 要試過才知道好不好；先試用這個應用程式吧。

examples.source: The proof is in the pudding, so let the results speak.
examples.target: 要看結果才知道好不好，所以讓成果說話吧。

examples.source: They say the proof is in the pudding after the test.
examples.target: 他們說測試後才知道是否真的有效。

there is no going back.meaning: 無法回頭 / 從此不能回頭

examples.source: After we sign the contract, there is no going back.
examples.target: 簽合約後，我們就無法回頭。

examples.source: Once the news is posted online, there is no going back.
examples.target: 消息一旦放上網，就從此不能回頭。

examples.source: There is no going back after the final decision.
examples.target: 作出最終決定後便無法回頭。

there is something to be said for.meaning: 有可取之處 / 有值得考慮的地方

examples.source: There is something to be said for studying in a quiet room.
examples.target: 在安靜房間溫習是有可取之處的。

examples.source: There is something to be said for walking to school.
examples.target: 步行上學也有值得考慮的地方。

examples.source: There is something to be said for keeping the old system.
examples.target: 保留舊制度也有可取之處。

there is still a place for.meaning: 仍然有存在價值 / 仍然有用武之地

examples.source: There is still a place for handwriting in schools.
examples.target: 手寫在學校仍然有存在價值。

examples.source: There is still a place for printed books today.
examples.target: 紙本書在今天仍然有用武之地。

examples.source: There is still a place for face-to-face lessons.
examples.target: 面授課堂仍然有存在價值。

examples.source: Good part-time jobs are thin on the ground this month.
examples.target: 今個月好的兼職工作很稀少。

examples.source: Tickets were thin on the ground after the concert went viral.
examples.target: 演唱會爆紅後，門票變得不多見。

examples.source: Quiet study spaces are thin on the ground near my home.
examples.target: 我家附近安靜的溫習地方很少。

thrive in solitude.meaning: 在獨處中茁壯 / 因獨處而成功

examples.source: Some writers thrive in solitude.
examples.target: 有些作家在獨處中茁壯。

examples.source: She thrives in solitude when she prepares for exams.
examples.target: 她準備考試時，因獨處而更有效率。

examples.source: Not everyone thrives in solitude; some need teamwork.
examples.target: 不是每個人都能在獨處中茁壯；有些人需要團隊合作。

examples.source: This plant seems to thrive on neglect.
examples.target: 這種植物似乎疏於照顧也能茁壯。

examples.source: Some online trends thrive on neglect and grow quietly.
examples.target: 有些網上潮流在無人理會下也會悄悄壯大。

examples.source: The cactus can thrive on neglect in a sunny room.
examples.target: 仙人掌在陽光充足的房間裏，疏於照顧也能長得好。

through no fault of one's own.meaning: 並非因自己犯錯 / 非因自身過失

examples.source: Through no fault of her own, she missed the bus.
examples.target: 她錯過巴士並非因自己犯錯。

examples.source: He lost the file through no fault of his own.
examples.target: 他遺失檔案並非因自身過失。

examples.source: The match was cancelled through no fault of the players.
examples.target: 比賽取消並不是球員的錯。

through the fault of.meaning: 由於...的過失 / 因...的錯

examples.source: The delay happened through the fault of the organiser.
examples.target: 延誤是由於主辦方的過失。

examples.source: The window broke through the fault of a careless worker.
examples.target: 窗戶破裂是因一名粗心工人的錯。

examples.source: The problem was not through the fault of the students.
examples.target: 這個問題不是學生的錯。

examples.source: He threw lunch down his throat before the meeting.
examples.target: 開會前，他狼吞虎嚥地吃下午餐。

examples.source: Do not throw food down your throat so quickly.
examples.target: 不要那麼快狼吞虎嚥地吃東西。

examples.source: She threw breakfast down her throat and ran to school.
examples.target: 她狼吞虎嚥地吃完早餐便跑去上學。

throw money in the sea.meaning: 浪費金錢 / 把錢倒進海裡

examples.source: Buying another broken printer is throwing money in the sea.
examples.target: 再買一部壞打印機就是浪費金錢。

examples.source: Without a plan, the project may throw money in the sea.
examples.target: 沒有計劃，這個項目可能會把錢倒進海裏。

examples.source: He felt the useless course threw money in the sea.
examples.target: 他覺得那個沒用的課程是在浪費金錢。

throw the baby out with the bathwater.meaning: 把好壞一起丟掉 / 因噎廢食

examples.source: Do not throw the baby out with the bathwater when you change the rules.
examples.target: 改規則時不要把好壞一起丟掉。

examples.source: Cancelling the whole project would throw the baby out with the bathwater.
examples.target: 取消整個項目就是因噎廢食。

examples.source: We can fix the app without throwing the baby out with the bathwater.
examples.target: 我們可以修好應用程式，不必把有用部分也丟掉。

examples.source: He threw up his job to start a small business.
examples.target: 他辭去工作去創辦小生意。

examples.source: She did not want to throw up a stable job too quickly.
examples.target: 她不想太快辭去穩定工作。

examples.source: The article explains why young people throw up jobs.
examples.target: 文章解釋年輕人辭去工作的原因。

tick off one's bucket list.meaning: 完成願望清單上的一項

examples.source: She ticked skydiving off her bucket list.
examples.target: 她完成了願望清單上的跳傘。

examples.source: Visiting Japan helped him tick off his bucket list.
examples.target: 到日本旅行讓他完成願望清單上的一項。

examples.source: I want to tick off learning French from my bucket list.
examples.target: 我想完成願望清單上學法文這一項。

tick over.meaning: 跳到下一個數字 / 轉到新階段

examples.source: The counter ticked over to one million views.
examples.target: 計數器跳到一百萬觀看次數。

examples.source: The clock ticked over to midnight.
examples.target: 時鐘跳到午夜。

examples.source: Our class record ticked over to day ten.
examples.target: 我們班的紀錄轉到第十天。

tie up in.meaning: 與...緊密相連 / 被...牽制

examples.source: His confidence is tied up in exam results.
examples.target: 他的自信與考試成績緊密相連。

examples.source: Do not tie your happiness up in one goal.
examples.target: 不要讓快樂被單一目標牽制。

examples.source: The issue is tied up in family history.
examples.target: 這個問題與家庭歷史緊密相連。

tie up in a neat bow.meaning: 圓滿收結 / 把情節收拾得妥當

examples.source: The final chapter ties everything up in a neat bow.
examples.target: 最後一章把所有情節收拾得妥當。

examples.source: Real life does not always tie up in a neat bow.
examples.target: 現實生活不一定會圓滿收結。

examples.source: The movie tied the story up in a neat bow.
examples.target: 電影把故事圓滿收結。

tie-in.meaning: 配合安排 / 聯繫合作

examples.source: The toy was a tie-in with the new film.
examples.target: 這款玩具是配合新電影推出的聯繫產品。

examples.source: The school planned a tie-in with a local museum.
examples.target: 學校計劃與本地博物館合作安排。

examples.source: The campaign included a tie-in with several cafés.
examples.target: 這個活動包括與幾間咖啡店的聯繫合作。

tinker with.meaning: 小修小改 / 嘗試改動

examples.source: He likes to tinker with old computers.
examples.target: 他喜歡小修小改舊電腦。

examples.source: The teacher tinkered with the lesson plan.
examples.target: 老師嘗試改動課堂計劃。

examples.source: Do not tinker with the settings unless you understand them.
examples.target: 除非你明白設定，否則不要隨便改動。

examples.source: Everyone was nervous to a greater or lesser degree.
examples.target: 每個人或多或少都有點緊張。

examples.source: All students need support to a greater or lesser degree.
examples.target: 所有學生或多或少都需要支援。

examples.source: The change affected every class to a greater or lesser degree.
examples.target: 這個改變或多或少影響了每班。

to a t.meaning: 完全地 / 恰到好處地

examples.source: The uniform fits him to a T.
examples.target: 這套校服非常合身。

examples.source: She followed the instructions to a T.
examples.target: 她完全按照指示去做。

examples.source: The role suits her to a T.
examples.target: 這個角色非常適合她。

to add insult to injury.meaning: 更糟的是 / 雪上加霜的是

examples.source: To add insult to injury, it started raining.
examples.target: 雪上加霜的是，天開始下雨。

examples.source: He missed the bus, and to add insult to injury, he forgot his wallet.
examples.target: 他錯過巴士，更糟的是，他忘了帶銀包。

examples.source: To add insult to injury, the replacement phone was broken too.
examples.target: 更糟的是，替換手機也壞了。

examples.source: The bag is cheap and stylish to boot.
examples.target: 這個袋便宜，而且很時尚。

examples.source: She is kind, hardworking, and funny to boot.
examples.target: 她善良、勤力，而且很幽默。

examples.source: The room is bright and quiet to boot.
examples.target: 這個房間光猛，此外也很安靜。

examples.source: I called several times, but to no avail.
examples.target: 我打了幾次電話，但徒勞無功。

examples.source: They tried to fix the printer, to no avail.
examples.target: 他們嘗試修理打印機，但無效。

examples.source: She searched for her keys to no avail.
examples.target: 她尋找鎖匙，但徒勞無功。

examples.source: The noise annoyed me to no end.
examples.target: 噪音令我非常煩躁。

examples.source: Her kindness helped the class to no end.
examples.target: 她的善良對全班幫助極大。

examples.source: The delay frustrated the passengers to no end.
examples.target: 延誤令乘客非常沮喪。

to one's detriment.meaning: 對自己不利地 / 損害自己地

examples.source: He ignored his health to his detriment.
examples.target: 他忽視健康，結果對自己不利。

examples.source: She studied without rest, to her detriment.
examples.target: 她不休息地溫習，結果損害了自己。

examples.source: Do not chase marks to your detriment.
examples.target: 不要為了追分數而損害自己。

to one's heart's content.meaning: 盡情地 / 心滿意足地

examples.source: The children played to their heart's content.
examples.target: 孩子們盡情地玩。

examples.source: You can read to your heart's content in the library.
examples.target: 你可以在圖書館盡情閱讀。

examples.source: She sang to her heart's content after the exam.
examples.target: 考試後，她心滿意足地盡情唱歌。

to put it mildly.meaning: 說得客氣一點 / 說得婉轉一點

examples.source: The test was difficult, to put it mildly.
examples.target: 說得客氣一點，測驗很難。

examples.source: He was disappointed, to put it mildly.
examples.target: 說得婉轉一點，他很失望。

examples.source: The room was messy, to put it mildly.
examples.target: 說得客氣一點，房間很凌亂。

examples.source: The trip was tiring, to say nothing of the cost.
examples.target: 這趟旅程很累，更不用說費用了。

examples.source: The app saves time, to say nothing of paper.
examples.target: 這個應用程式節省時間，還未計紙張。

examples.source: The storm damaged roads, to say nothing of homes.
examples.target: 暴風雨破壞道路，更不用說房屋了。

to that end.meaning: 為此 / 為達到這目的

examples.source: We need better notes; to that end, I made a checklist.
examples.target: 我們需要更好的筆記；為此，我做了一張清單。

examples.source: The school wants less waste and, to that end, added recycling bins.
examples.target: 學校想減少廢物，為達到這目的增設回收箱。

examples.source: She wanted to improve her writing; to that end, she read daily.
examples.target: 她想改善寫作；為此，她每天閱讀。

to that end.meaning: 為此 / 為了達到那個目的

examples.source: The team needs more data; to that end, we ran a survey.
examples.target: 團隊需要更多數據；為此，我們做了一個問卷調查。

examples.source: He hopes to speak more clearly; to that end, he practises aloud.
examples.target: 他希望說話更清楚；為了達到那個目的，他大聲練習。

examples.source: We want safer roads and, to that end, asked for better lighting.
examples.target: 我們想道路更安全，為此要求改善照明。

examples.source: She sang to the accompaniment of a piano.
examples.target: 她在鋼琴伴奏下唱歌。

examples.source: We ate dinner to the accompaniment of soft music.
examples.target: 我們伴隨着柔和音樂吃晚飯。

examples.source: The ceremony began to the accompaniment of drums.
examples.target: 典禮在鼓聲伴奏下開始。

to the contrary.meaning: 相反地 / 與此相反地

examples.source: Many people expected rain, but evidence to the contrary appeared.
examples.target: 很多人預期會下雨，但出現了相反證據。

examples.source: Unless you hear anything to the contrary, the lesson starts at nine.
examples.target: 除非你聽到相反消息，否則課堂九時開始。

examples.source: He claimed he was calm, but his face suggested the contrary.
examples.target: 他聲稱自己很冷靜，但他的表情顯示相反。

to the dismay of.meaning: 令...失望 / 令...沮喪的是

examples.source: To the dismay of the class, the trip was cancelled.
examples.target: 令全班失望的是，旅行取消了。

examples.source: The café closed, to the dismay of its regular customers.
examples.target: 咖啡店結業，令常客很沮喪。

examples.source: To the dismay of fans, the match ended early.
examples.target: 令球迷失望的是，比賽提早結束。

to the exclusion of.meaning: 排除... / 只顧...而忽略其他

examples.source: He focused on marks to the exclusion of health.
examples.target: 他只顧分數而忽略健康。

examples.source: The club chose older members to the exclusion of beginners.
examples.target: 學會選擇資深會員，排除了初學者。

examples.source: Do not study grammar to the exclusion of reading.
examples.target: 不要只顧文法而忽略閱讀。

to the extent that.meaning: 到...的程度 / 在...程度上

examples.source: The room was crowded to the extent that we could not move.
examples.target: 房間擠迫到我們不能移動的程度。

examples.source: He improved to the extent that he could join the debate team.
examples.target: 他進步到可以加入辯論隊的程度。

examples.source: The app helps to the extent that students practise every day.
examples.target: 這個應用程式在學生每天練習的程度上有幫助。

examples.source: To the horror of the audience, the lights suddenly went out.
examples.target: 令觀眾驚恐的是，燈突然熄滅。

examples.source: The file disappeared, to the horror of the student.
examples.target: 檔案消失了，令那名學生很驚恐。

examples.source: To the horror of everyone, the cake fell on the floor.
examples.target: 令所有人驚恐的是，蛋糕跌在地上。

examples.source: The repairs cost to the tune of ten thousand dollars.
examples.target: 維修費用達一萬元之多。

examples.source: The campaign raised donations to the tune of two million dollars.
examples.target: 活動籌得善款達二百萬元之多。

examples.source: The mistake led to losses to the tune of several weeks' income.
examples.target: 這個錯誤造成的損失達數星期收入之多。

to the utmost.meaning: 盡最大程度 / 盡力地

examples.source: She used her time to the utmost before the exam.
examples.target: 考試前，她盡最大程度善用時間。

examples.source: We will help you to the utmost.
examples.target: 我們會盡力幫助你。

examples.source: The team trained to the utmost for the final.
examples.target: 隊伍為決賽盡力訓練。

examples.source: The students toiled away on their science project.
examples.target: 學生們為科學專題辛苦工作。

examples.source: She toiled away in the kitchen all afternoon.
examples.target: 她整個下午在廚房苦幹。

examples.source: Many workers toil away behind the scenes.
examples.target: 許多工人在幕後辛苦工作。

tongue-in-cheek.meaning: 半開玩笑的 / 不完全認真的

examples.source: His comment was tongue-in-cheek, not rude.
examples.target: 他的評論是半開玩笑的，不是無禮。

examples.source: The article has a tongue-in-cheek title.
examples.target: 這篇文章有一個半開玩笑的標題。

examples.source: She gave a tongue-in-cheek answer to the question.
examples.target: 她對這個問題作出不完全認真的回答。

examples.source: The bank was seen as too-big-to-fail.
examples.target: 這間銀行被視為大到不能倒。

examples.source: A too-big-to-fail company may receive government support.
examples.target: 大到不能倒的公司可能會得到政府支援。

examples.source: The essay questions whether any business should be too-big-to-fail.
examples.target: 文章質疑是否應有企業大到不能倒。

examples.source: Do not toy with other people's feelings.
examples.target: 不要玩弄別人的感情。

examples.source: He toyed with the idea of studying overseas.
examples.target: 他曾不太認真地考慮出國讀書。

examples.source: The company toyed with a new logo but kept the old one.
examples.target: 公司曾嘗試考慮新標誌，但保留了舊標誌。

examples.source: The results track with what teachers see in class.
examples.target: 結果與老師在課堂所見相符。

examples.source: Her story does not track with the evidence.
examples.target: 她的說法與證據不一致。

examples.source: The survey tracks with students' comments.
examples.target: 問卷結果跟學生意見一致。

examples.source: The team traded optimism for pragmatism after the first failure.
examples.target: 第一次失敗後，團隊以務實取代樂觀。

examples.source: She traded optimism for pragmatism and made a safer plan.
examples.target: 她以務實取代樂觀，制定了更穩妥的計劃。

examples.source: The article says leaders must trade optimism for pragmatism.
examples.target: 文章指領袖必須以務實取代樂觀。

traipse around.meaning: 到處奔波 / 疲累地四處走

examples.source: We traipsed around the city looking for the museum.
examples.target: 我們在城中疲累地四處走，尋找博物館。

examples.source: She had to traipse around several shops for one book.
examples.target: 她為了一本書要到幾間店到處奔波。

examples.source: Nobody wanted to traipse around in the rain.
examples.target: 沒有人想在雨中到處奔波。

examples.source: The rule should not trample on students' privacy.
examples.target: 這條規則不應踐踏學生私隱。

examples.source: Do not trample on other people's opinions.
examples.target: 不要不尊重別人的意見。

examples.source: The crowd trampled on the flowers near the gate.
examples.target: 人群踐踏了閘口附近的花。

examples.source: Many newspapers transitioned from print to digital.
examples.target: 許多報章由印刷轉為數碼形式。

examples.source: The school will transition from print to digital worksheets.
examples.target: 學校會由印刷工作紙轉為數碼工作紙。

examples.source: The transition from print to digital saved storage space.
examples.target: 由印刷轉為數碼形式節省了儲存空間。

examples.source: He trembled with nerves before the speech.
examples.target: 演講前，他緊張得發抖。

examples.source: My hands trembled with nerves during the piano exam.
examples.target: 鋼琴考試期間，我的手緊張得發抖。

examples.source: She trembled with nerves but still answered clearly.
examples.target: 她緊張得發抖，但仍然清楚回答。

examples.source: New cafés trended in the wake of the dessert craze.
examples.target: 甜品熱潮之後，新咖啡店流行起來。

examples.source: Short videos trended in the wake of the app's success.
examples.target: 那個應用程式成功後，短片流行起來。

examples.source: Several study habits trended in her wake.
examples.target: 在她之後，幾種溫習習慣流行起來。

trickle down.meaning: 逐漸傳到 / 向下滲透

examples.source: The benefits did not trickle down to small shops.
examples.target: 好處沒有逐漸傳到小店。

examples.source: New ideas can trickle down from universities to schools.
examples.target: 新想法可以由大學逐漸傳到學校。

examples.source: The policy took years to trickle down to ordinary families.
examples.target: 這項政策花了多年才逐漸惠及普通家庭。

examples.source: The article warns readers about trolls-for-hire.
examples.target: 文章提醒讀者留意受僱網絡打手。

examples.source: A troll-for-hire may post fake comments online.
examples.target: 受僱網絡打手可能會在網上發表假評論。

examples.source: Students discussed how to spot a troll-for-hire.
examples.target: 學生討論如何識別受僱網絡打手。

true to the time.meaning: 符合那個年代的 / 有時代真實感的

examples.source: The costumes are true to the time of the story.
examples.target: 服裝符合故事那個年代。

examples.source: The film feels true to the time it describes.
examples.target: 這部電影對所描寫的年代很有真實感。

examples.source: Her diary is true to the time and place.
examples.target: 她的日記符合當時的時代和地方背景。

examples.source: The drawing is true-to-life.
examples.target: 這幅畫很逼真。

examples.source: The game uses true-to-life sound effects.
examples.target: 這個遊戲使用逼真的音效。

examples.source: Her story was simple but true-to-life.
examples.target: 她的故事簡單但像真的。

truth dawns on.meaning: 真相逐漸明白 / 恍然大悟

examples.source: The truth dawned on him after he checked the receipt.
examples.target: 他查看收據後才逐漸明白真相。

examples.source: The truth slowly dawned on the class.
examples.target: 全班慢慢恍然大悟。

examples.source: When she saw the empty box, the truth dawned on her.
examples.target: 她看到空盒時，真相逐漸明白了。

examples.source: The long delay tried everyone's patience.
examples.target: 漫長延誤考驗了所有人的耐性。

examples.source: His constant excuses tried the teacher's patience.
examples.target: 他不斷找藉口，考驗了老師的耐性。

examples.source: A slow computer can try your patience.
examples.target: 很慢的電腦可以考驗你的耐性。

turn off the tide.meaning: 阻止問題浪潮 / 從源頭制止

examples.source: Better education can turn off the tide of online scams.
examples.target: 更好的教育可以從源頭制止網上騙案浪潮。

examples.source: The policy aims to turn off the tide of food waste.
examples.target: 這項政策旨在阻止食物浪費浪潮。

examples.source: Early support may turn off the tide of student stress.
examples.target: 及早支援或可從源頭制止學生壓力問題。

turn on its head.meaning: 徹底顛覆 / 完全改變

examples.source: The new discovery turned the old theory on its head.
examples.target: 新發現徹底顛覆了舊理論。

examples.source: Online learning turned the school routine on its head.
examples.target: 網上學習完全改變了學校日常。

examples.source: The ending turns the whole story on its head.
examples.target: 結局徹底顛覆了整個故事。

turn one's hand to.meaning: 開始嘗試做 / 著手做

examples.source: She turned her hand to baking during the holiday.
examples.target: 假期期間，她開始嘗試烘焙。

examples.source: He can turn his hand to almost any task.
examples.target: 他幾乎任何工作都能著手做。

examples.source: The class turned its hand to making a short film.
examples.target: 全班開始嘗試製作短片。

turn one's stomach.meaning: 令人反胃 / 令人作嘔

examples.source: The smell of rotten food turned my stomach.
examples.target: 腐爛食物的氣味令我反胃。

examples.source: The unfair treatment turned her stomach.
examples.target: 不公平的對待令她作嘔。

examples.source: That scene may turn some viewers' stomachs.
examples.target: 那個場面可能會令部分觀眾反胃。

examples.source: My teacher turned me on to poetry.
examples.target: 我的老師令我對詩產生興趣。

examples.source: The documentary turned many students on to science.
examples.target: 紀錄片令很多學生對科學產生興趣。

examples.source: A good book can turn children on to reading.
examples.target: 一本好書可以令孩子對閱讀產生興趣。

examples.source: The invention turned communication on its head.
examples.target: 這項發明徹底改變了溝通方式。

examples.source: The teacher turned the lesson on its head with one question.
examples.target: 老師用一個問題顛覆了整堂課。

examples.source: The evidence turned the case on its head.
examples.target: 證據徹底改變了案件走向。

turn up one's nose.meaning: 嗤之以鼻 / 表示嫌棄

examples.source: He turned up his nose at the simple lunch.
examples.target: 他對簡單的午餐表示嫌棄。

examples.source: Do not turn up your nose at honest work.
examples.target: 不要對正當工作嗤之以鼻。

examples.source: Some students turned up their noses at old books.
examples.target: 有些學生對舊書表示嫌棄。
